jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:### **Position Overview**


The Executive Assistant \& Project Coordinator is a key support role for the President and the broader organization. This position is ideal for someone who naturally takes ownership, follows through, stays organized, and enjoys figuring out what needs to happen next.


You will manage and follow up on the President’s priorities, coordinate smaller projects and business initiatives, communicate with employees and outside partners, and provide administrative and occasional personal\-assistant support.


The successful candidate will not simply wait for the next task. They will **anticipate needs, keep projects moving, identify potential problems, follow up consistently, and close the loop on outstanding items.**


This is a hands\-on position in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. The ability to move comfortably between executive support, project coordination, administrative work, and special assignments is essential.

### **What You'll Do**

#### **Executive Support \& Task Management**

* Manage and maintain a centralized list of the President’s priorities, assignments, commitments, and pending decisions.
* Turn conversations, meetings, emails, and verbal direction into clear action items and deadlines.
* Follow up with employees, vendors, clients, contractors, and other contacts to ensure commitments are completed.
* Keep the President informed of progress, upcoming deadlines, outstanding items, and issues requiring attention.
* Resolve routine matters independently whenever possible.
* Help protect the President’s time by organizing information and bringing forward solutions rather than simply identifying problems.
* Anticipate scheduling, administrative, and logistical needs.

#### **Project Coordination**

* Coordinate smaller projects, business initiatives, facility matters, acquisitions, and special assignments.
* Maintain project timelines, task lists, budgets, purchases, deliverables, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with employees, vendors, clients, contractors, and service providers.
* Request and organize quotes and assist with comparing options and coordinating approvals.
* Schedule meetings, deliveries, installations, service appointments, inspections, and other project activities.
* Track estimates, invoices, receipts, purchases, and change requests.
* Identify delays, risks, and unresolved issues and recommend appropriate next steps.
* Follow projects through completion and ensure closeout items and records are organized.

#### **Administrative Support to the President**

* Manage calendar appointments, meetings, reminders, and scheduling priorities.
* Prepare correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, presentations, and meeting materials.
* Organize files, records, communications, and reference materials.
* Prepare for meetings by gathering information, confirming logistics, and documenting follow\-up items.
* Draft and coordinate routine communications on behalf of the President.
* Assist with travel arrangements, reservations, itineraries, and related logistics.
* Handle confidential company, employee, financial, client, and personal information with discretion.

#### **Personal Assistant Support**

* Assist with occasional personal appointments, reservations, purchases, errands, and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate personal and professional commitments.
* Research products, services, vendors, events, and other requested matters and present organized options.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and discretion when handling personal or confidential information.

#### **General Administration \& Special Projects**

* Support company\-wide administrative initiatives and special projects.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical records.
* Assist with data entry, document preparation, filing, and other administrative tasks as needed.
* Provide administrative support to other departments when directed by the President.
* Take on additional responsibilities as the company’s needs evolve.


Requirements:### **What We're Looking For**

* **Proactive:** You see what needs to be done and take action without waiting to be reminded.
* **Highly organized:** You can manage multiple projects, deadlines, conversations, and priorities without losing track of details.
* **Accountable:** When you take ownership of something, you follow it through to completion.
* **Resourceful:** You are comfortable researching answers, finding solutions, and figuring things out.
* **A strong communicator:** You communicate clearly, professionally, and consistently.
* **Detail\-oriented:** You catch missing information, deadlines, discrepancies, and potential problems.
* **Discreet:** You understand the importance of confidentiality when working with executive, financial, employee, client, and personal information.
* **Adaptable:** You can shift priorities and remain composed when the day does not go according to plan.
* **Solutions\-oriented:** You don't just bring problems forward — you think through possible solutions and next steps.

### **Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in executive assistance, administrative support, project coordination, office management, or a related role.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong follow\-through and ability to work independently.
* Strong research, documentation, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, calendars, task\-management platforms, and standard business software.
* Ability to learn new software and systems quickly.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for occasional company\-related errands, appointments, or project needs.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Program Coordinator - Cellular and Gene Therapy - Hybrid
jobs.description:
**Job ID** 20247 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Compliance / Quality **Date posted** 09/22/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


When the work you do every single day has a crucial impact on the lives of others, every effort, every detail, and every second matters. This shared culture of passion and dedication pulses through Cedars\-Sinai, and it’s just one of the many reasons it was recognized by **U.S. News \& World Report’s ‘Best Hospitals’ Honor Roll for the eleventh consecutive year and tied \#1 in California \& Los Angeles**. Cedars\-Sinai continues to be acknowledged as a world leader in patient care, education, and research.


Our 915\-bed nonprofit, acute, tertiary, teaching Level I trauma center hospital is in the heart of Los Angeles. The Pharmacy Department has over 500 team members who are dedicated on providing both inpatient and outpatient pharmacy services, ensuring that patients receive high\-quality care tailored to their needs.


Join Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center at the forefront of one of the most transformative areas of medicine. The Cellular and Gene Therapy (CGT) Pharmacist Coordinator will serve as a clinical, operational, and strategic pharmacy leader in building and advancing a comprehensive CGT program across the health system. In this highly collaborative role, you will help design the infrastructure, governance, workflows, and partnerships needed to safely and effectively evaluate, procure, coordinate, administer, and monitor commercially approved, investigational, and emerging CGT products. Working closely with physicians, pharmacists, laboratory and research teams, finance leaders, and other key stakeholders, you will help translate innovative therapies into accessible, efficient, and patient\-centered care. As the CGT field continues to evolve, you will identify emerging opportunities, support strategic planning, and help shape the future of therapy delivery at Cedars\-Sinai. Your leadership will contribute to the safe, equitable, and financially responsible growth of CGT services while advancing the organization’s clinical, academic, and research missions.


This position has a flexible hybrid opportunity (up to 50% remote) and inpatient staffing (1 weekend per month) requirement.


\#LI\-RD1

------------------


**Educational Requirements:**
=============================


* Pharm.D. degree from an accredited School of Pharmacy
* Completion of a PGY1 residency or equivalent practice experience

**License/Certification/Registration Requirements:**
====================================================


* Current pharmacist licensure in the State of California.
* BLS certification upon hire

**What else are we looking for?**
=================================


* Passionate about advancing innovative therapies for patients with rare and difficult to treat conditions and helping patients navigate the complexities of the healthcare system
* Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate complex clinical, operational, financial, and scientific information clearly to diverse audiences
* Maintains a strategic, forward\-looking perspective on the cellular and gene therapy pipeline and identifies opportunities to prepare the organization for new therapies, technologies, indications, and treatment models
* Is comfortable working in an evolving environment where evidence, processes, and best practices continue to develop
* Maintains an excellent clinical database and critical thinking skills, including the ability to provide recommendations on the management of complex patients, utilizing organizational policies and evidence\-based medicine
* Is patient\-centered and committed to promoting equitable access to complex, high\-cost therapies while understanding the clinical, financial, and psychosocial challenges faced by patients and families
* Possesses experience in drug information services and formulary development
* Exhibits excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrates ability to prioritize projects to meet goals

jobs.title: Inside Sales
jobs.description:
Description:  



**Position Summary**


We are seeking an organized, detail\-oriented Inside Sales / Project Coordinator to support our sales team and coordinate projects from initial inquiry through quoting, submittals, approvals, and production release. This role partners closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Shipping, as well as external sales reps, dealers, customers, and contractors to ensure projects are quoted accurately, documented correctly, and executed on schedule.


The ideal candidate has experience reading blueprints or construction drawings, preparing quotes and proposals, coordinating multiple projects, and providing excellent customer service. Experience in restaurant equipment, commercial kitchens, manufacturing, construction, millwork, stainless\-steel fabrication, or a related industry is preferred.


Requirements:  



**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Prepare quotes and proposals in AutoQuotes; support special\-order pricing and product substitutions as needed. Ensure quotes and submittal packages are delivered accurately and on time.
* Review architectural/equipment plans, specifications, and shop drawings to identify requirements, constraints, and scope gaps.
* Coordinate submittal and drawing packages with internal teams and external parties; manage drawing revisions and approval cycles.
* Confirm product dimensions, finishes, quantities, and specifications prior to production release.
* Maintain accurate project files, correspondence, and status updates in company systems.
* Coordinate projects from the sales and estimating stages through production, delivery, and installation coordination.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for sales representatives, dealers, and consultants regarding project status and documentation.
* Communicate schedule risks, missing information, and conflicts early to keep projects on track.
* Track project schedules, manufacturing timelines, approvals, deliveries, and installation dates.
* Track quote status and follow up on, pending approvals, customer questions, and outstanding project information.
* Identify potential project conflicts, missing information, or scheduling concerns and communicate them promptly.
* Provide customers and outside sales representatives with timely project updates.
* Help resolve issues such as order discrepancies, manufacturing errors, and other customer concerns in partnership with internal teams.
* Participate in sales meetings and provide updates on active projects.
* Develop strong working relationships with customers and support repeat business opportunities.
* Perform additional sales\-support and project\-coordination duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business, construction management, engineering, design, or a related field is preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in inside sales, project coordination, estimating, manufacturing, construction, restaurant equipment, or a related industry preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, equipment plans, architectural plans, specifications, equipment schedules, and/or shop drawings.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Customer\-service\-focused approach with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with outside sales and internal departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Experience using CRM, ERP, quoting, order\-entry, or project\-management software is preferred.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, measurements, dimensions, materials, and lead times is preferred.
* Experience with commercial restaurant equipment, stainless\-steel fabrication, millwork, cabinetry, refrigeration, or food\-service construction is a plus.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Equipment plan, drawing, specification reading
* Experience with AutoQuotes is a plus
* Quoting and estimating support
* Project coordination
* Estimating and quoting
* Order and change\-order management
* Cross\-functional communication (Sales/Engineering/Production)
* Scheduling and deadline management
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution
* Documentation and recordkeeping
* Cross\-functional teamwork
* Accuracy and attention to detail

**Physical and Work Requirements**

* Ability to work primarily in an office and manufacturing environment.
* Ability to sit, stand, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to walk through production areas and active project sites when necessary. and follow all safety policies when in production areas (PPE as required).
* Occasional lifting of samples, documents, or materials weighing up to 25 pounds.

At Equitable, we help clients secure their financial well\-being so they can pursue long and fulfilling lives \- a mission we’ve honed since 1859\.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in keeping our branch operating seamlessly while delivering an exceptional experience to both our clients and internal teams.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Collaborate with the Office Coordinator to oversee daily office operations, including mail distribution, conference room scheduling, and supply management

* Assist with branch event planning, meeting preparation, and other administrative needs, including required travel to branch locations and off\-site events
* Recruiting support for District Managers, sourcing, screening, setting interviews, tracking
* Maintain office functionality by ordering and tracking pantry and office supplies and managing incoming mail

* Ensure checks, correspondence, and other critical mail are received and processed expeditiously
* Provide high\-level administrative support to leadership, including VP\-level support

This role requires full\-time, in\-office presence Monday through Friday, aligning with core hours (8:30 AM–5:15 PM EST) to ensure consistent, real\-time support and a high\-quality customer experience.


The base salary range for this position is $55,000 \- $65,000\. Actual base salaries vary based on skills, experience, and geographical location. * 2\+ years of experience in a business office or administrative environment, demonstrating reliability and strong operational execution

* Strong technical proficiency, with the ability to effectively utilize business systems, tools, and software applications

* Ability to train and mentor employees

jobs.description:
**About Us**

We’re a fast\-paced, growing fire sprinkler company that keeps buildings safe and compliant. Our team is hardworking, supportive, and driven to get the job done right the first time. We’re seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Operations Coordinator to help keep our company running smoothly. If you’re skilled with Excel, enjoy keeping things organized, have strong verbal and written communication skills, and have a team\-first attitude, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting our technicians, customers, and management. Typical responsibilities include:

· Schedule foremen and field personnel across multiple active projects based on manpower needs and project timelines

· Develop and maintain accurate manpower load charts to support workforce planning and forecasting

· Order and coordinate delivery of materials to ensure timely jobsite availability

· Order, schedule, and track rental equipment and specialty tools

· Assist in preparation for and participation in project coordination meetings

· Communicate regularly with Project Managers, Engineering, Superintendent, and field staff to support operational efficiency

· Track and adjust schedules as project needs evolve

· Support documentation and reporting related to manpower, equipment, and material allocation

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2\+ years of administrative or office experience (construction or fire protection is a plus).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, sorting/filtering, basic functions) and Outlook (email/calendar).
* Excellent communication skills — both written and verbal.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A team player with a positive attitude who is also comfortable working independently.

**Bonus Points For:**

* Experience working with fire sprinkler, fire protection, or construction service companies.
* Familiarity with billing and invoicing processes.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay (DOE)
* Health, dental, vision, life insurance and retirement benefits
* Paid time off and holidays.
* A supportive, team\-first work environment.
* Opportunities to learn and grow in the fire protection industry.

**Schedule**

* Full\-time: Monday–Friday, 7:00 am \-4:00 pm
* Occasional overtime may be required during urgent projects.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

TJ Maxx
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Opportunity: Grow Your Career**


Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

* Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
* Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
* Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor
* Trains and mentors Associates on established merchandising and processing principles
* Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
* Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
* Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
* Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
* Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
* Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
* Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
* Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
* Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
* Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
* Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
* Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
* Promotes credit and loyalty programs
* Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
* Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For: You.**

* Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
* Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of multi\-tasking
* Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
* Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
* Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
* Able to train others
* 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience


Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care \& cell phone discounts; pet \& legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.


In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

18295 Brookhurst St**Location:**


USA TJ Maxx Store 0660 Fountain Valley CA

jobs.title: SOCIAL MEDIA + PR ACCOUNT COORDINATOR / JR. ACCOUNT MANAGER / ACCOUNT MANAGER
jobs.description:
RAGDOLL PR is looking for a creative, highly organized \+ social media\-savvy **Account Coordinator or Jr. Account Manager** (maybe even Account Manager) to join our growing team and work across our fashion, beauty, wellness, health \+ lifestyle clients.

This role is ideal for someone who **lives and breathes social media**, has a strong eye for content \+ branding, understands what performs across IG and TikTok, and also has experience within PR, influencer relations and/or brand communications.

A major part of this position will be **managing social media accounts for multiple RAGDOLL PR clients**, so we are specifically looking for someone who has hands\-on experience managing brand accounts and creating content. Candidates must be able to provide examples of social accounts they have managed as well as content they have personally created.

This is not strictly a social media position. The role will also support influencer collaborations, creator outreach, media relations \+ general PR account work depending on client needs.

RAGDOLL PR is a full\-service PR agency based in Manhattan Beach (Los Angeles), specializing in media relations, influencer \+ creator collaborations, celebrity/VIP PR and social media management.

This is a **full\-time hybrid position**, with three days per week in our Manhattan Beach office \+ two days WFH. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long\-term career with RAGDOLL PR and grow within the company.

**ROLE \+ RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Social Media \+ Content**

* Manage multiple client social media accounts, primarily IG with some TikTok support
* Develop monthly social media strategies \+ content calendars tailored to each client's brand, audience \+ goals
* Plan, create, schedule \+ publish engaging social content including Reels, Stories, carousels, static posts \+ short\-form video
* Write social copy \+ captions that reflect each client's individual brand voice
* Concept \+ create original content and identify opportunities using existing client assets
* Edit short\-form video/Reels and create graphics using Canva \+ other relevant editing tools
* Stay extremely current on social media trends, trending audio, platform updates, emerging creators \+ cultural moments
* Identify trends quickly and determine how they can be adapted appropriately for different client brands
* Manage daily community engagement, including comments, DMs \+ proactive engagement
* Monitor account performance \+ analytics and make recommendations based on what is/isn't working
* Participate in content shoots \+ help develop shot lists, concepts \+ creative direction when needed
* Maintain a strong visual eye and ensure client feeds/content remain cohesive \+ on\-brand
* Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously while keeping calendars, approvals \+ deliverables organized

**Influencer \+ PR**

* Identify, research \+ conduct outreach to relevant influencers \+ creators
* Manage influencer collaborations from outreach through execution, deliverables \+ reporting
* Coordinate organic gifting/seeding \+ product send\-outs
* Build \+ maintain relationships with influencers, creators \+ relevant industry contacts
* Support media relations, including research, media list building, pitching \+ follow\-up
* Assist with press releases, pitches, media alerts \+ other client\-facing materials
* Contribute creative ideas to client brainstorms, campaigns \+ PR/social strategies
* Participate in client calls and communicate directly with clients as appropriate
* Prepare weekly/monthly client updates, reports, recaps \+ trackers
* Support day\-to\-day account management across multiple fashion, beauty, wellness, health \+ lifestyle brands

**Business Unit**: Company 3  

**Position**: Production Coordinator  

**Location**: Santa Monica, CA (Onsite)  

**Requisition Number:** 1038  

* **Pay Range**: $24\.00 \- $26\.00 USD hourly

  

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

The Episodic Production Coordinator functions as an extension of a lead producer and be a main point of contact while working with internal and external teams to organize, supervise, and monitor the progress of projects. Possessing a sense of urgency, the Episodic Production Coordinator demonstrates an ability to work within a fast\-paced and collaborative environment, delivering accurate and quality work on schedule, and has excellent skills in building relationships and communicating effectively. In an operations capacity, this role requires a highly professional demeanor and diplomacy when dealing with clients, production management, coworkers, and artists. The Production Coordinator reports into the Head of Production and actively provides support and executes task\-based work for the episodic finishing producing team.
Location: This position will require working in our Santa Monica studio on a regular basis. You may also be required to travel and work out of our studio in Hollywood, as needed.


Hours: 3 PM \- 11:35 PM Monday \- Friday. Available to work overtime and variable shifts, including late nights, weekends and holidays, as necessary per business needs.

 **MAIN DUTIES:**  

The Production Coordinator will help the Lead Producer manage and drive online, color and delivery schedules. They will act as a main point of contact alongside your producer for their internal CO3 team and clients via in\-person interactions, e\-mail, and phone. They will also assist in maintaining effective communication with the internal team and clients regarding job status. They will help coordinate and verify project needs prior to any session start times and/or client arrivals as well as deliveries. They will help keep a pulse on all projects being produced including the status of individual show/episodes and budgets.
The following tasks illustrate some of the primary responsibilities:

* Firsthand communication with Producers upon arrival and throughout the day.
* Assist in the collection and logging of project statuses and key information.
* Keep the production team up to date on project status.
* Generate prep and post status reports, daily memos, and week at glances.
* Support episodic assists with project information, prioritizing tasks, and ensuring they have the elements to complete their tasks.
* Interface with client if required elements for jobs are missing.
* Assist producer in the creation, actualizing and billing of work orders.
* Ensure all resources assigned to job are available as scheduled.
* Make sure projects and resources are ready for sessions to begin on time.
* Work with Producer and assistants to troubleshoot any session related problems.
* Assist in greeting and escorting clients to the bays upon arrival.
* Assist in checking in on artists, clients, assists, and client services on a regular basis to make sure the session is well supported.
* Notify the Producer if any delivery deadlines that will or are in jeopardy of being missed.
* Setting up test feeds prior to session, including all face\-to\-face virtual interaction.
* Communicating with our Engineers if any network issues arise.
* Engage Engineering staff to resolve urgent technical problems.
* Project scheduling.
* Coordinating project details across sister facilities.

**WHAT YOU BRING:**  

The ideal candidate will bring a self\-starting and a positive, can\-do attitude. They will be adaptable, organized, and proactive. They will work great in collaboration with all members of a project. They will be perseverant under pressure in a quick pace environment. The ideal candidate will also bring the following:* Previous experience in Entertainment/Film/Arts.
* Episodic or Feature Finishing Post\-Production Experience.
* Basic knowledge of offline editing, VFX and sound workflows.
* Basic knowledge of scheduling the post process.
* Media Pulse and/or post\-production scheduling software experience.
* Background and/or knowledge of offline editing.
* Basic knowledge of task based software (ClickUp, Asana, Jira).

Company 3, including its various business units and family of brands, provides a full range of Creative Services for content creators, including conceptual design, pre\-vis, look development, ideation and rapid prototyping, 3D animation/CGI, motion graphics/designers, matte painting, compositing, dailies and production services, color grading, post\-production finishing, marketing/trailers, live\-action production, experiences, and more.

Creativity has diversity at its core. We celebrate the value of each unique experience by being dedicated to fostering the most diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture where every employee feels empowered and safe to show up to work as their full self.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About us**


We are a team of airline catering enthusiasts who believe flying is the greatest privilege and opportunity in the world and, believe it should be a nice experience for everyone. Air Fayre is an award\-winning catering team that is in search of the best and the brightest to join our dynamic team of airline catering enthusiasts.

**Air Fayre offers benefits including!**

* An excellent compensation package that includes a quarterly performance bonus program.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision for employees \& dependents at 80% premium sponsorship.
* Free short\- and long\-term disability insurance and life insurance
* 2\-4 weeks of paid vacation
* 401K with a match

 **Mission of role**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented Purchasing Coordinator to process replenishment orders for materials, supplies, and equipment under the direction of the Purchasing Manager. This role helps ensure accurate purchase orders, timely supplier confirmations and deliveries, and appropriate inventory levels across our 24/7 airline catering operation.


You’ll work closely with finance, operations, and leadership to maintain accurate


records and support month\-end processes.

**Functions and Responsibilities**

* Assist with invoicing, billing accuracy, and distribution
* Provide weekly and monthly ledger reconciliations, maintain an accurate AR aging report, aging review with comments and collections analysis to manager
* Resolve billing discrepancies and customer disputes
* Maintain accurate records in billing/accounting systems
* Review and assign G/L codes and process invoices
* Perform bank reconciliations and account reconciliations
* Support month\-end close, including accruals and journal entries
* Assist with financial reporting, including KPI tracking and analysis
* Prepare reports, trends, and commentary for leadership

 **Qualifications \& Educational Requirements**

* 2–4\+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or accounting
* Experience with reconciliations, invoicing, and collections
* Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas preferred)
* Understanding of basic accounting principles (G/L, accruals, reporting)
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment

  

Join us in our mission to uphold the highest standards of quality in our products while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. We look forward to your application!

**Regional Account Manager**
============================


When you join Brink's, you become part of a legacy of trust, security, and innovation that spans more than 165 years. We offer a competitive base salary with a performance\-driven commission structure, as well as ongoing career development and advancement opportunities. Whether your goal is to grow into a leadership role or expand your influence as a strategic client partner, Brink's gives you the platform to thrive.  

  



**Regional Account Manager**

  

  

At Brink's, we don't just deliver secure logistics \- we deliver peace of mind. You will play a critical role in deepening the relationships that fuel our business. You'll work closely with a portfolio of valued clients, becoming a trusted advisor who understands their unique needs and helps them unlock the full potential of Brink's integrated cash management and security solutions.

  

  

As a **Regional Account Manager,** you'll cultivate long\-term partnerships, identify new growth opportunities, and ensure our customers continue to see us as an essential part of their operations. You'll bring a proactive, strategic mindset to every interaction, uncovering ways to drive efficiency, reduce risk, and create meaningful impact for our clients.


If you're passionate about building lasting relationships, thrive on helping businesses grow, and want to be part of a high\-performance and transformative team with a strong sense of purpose, Brink's is where your career can truly take root.

  

  

**What You'll Do:**


* **Grow and strengthen existing customer relationships** by identifying opportunities to expand solution adoption and increase Brink's footprint within each account
* **Engage in regular, consultative conversations** with clients to understand their evolving business challenges and recommend tailored solutions
* **Uncover account growth opportunities** through performance analysis, market insights, and regular account reviews
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally** with internal teams \- from Customer Care and Operations to Product and Marketing \- to deliver seamless, value\-driven service
* **Deliver compelling presentations** using data, case studies, and industry trends to articulate the impact of Brink's offerings
* **Negotiate renewals and upsells**, ensuring each agreement aligns with the customer's needs and Brink's business goals
* **Use CRM tools (like Salesforce)** to manage your pipeline, track engagement, and forecast account growth
* **Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)** to align with key stakeholders, highlight results, and plan for continued success
* **Act as the voice of the customer**, sharing insights and feedback to help shape future offerings and enhance the client experience
  

  

**What You Bring:**


* A passion for relationship\-building and helping customers succeed
* 1\+ years of experience in account management, client success, or business development, ideally in a B2B environment
* Strong business acumen and a consultative approach to identifying customer needs and solutions
* Proven ability to engage and influence decision\-makers at all levels
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* A collaborative mindset with the ability to navigate cross\-functional teams and drive shared outcomes
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM platforms (preferably Salesforce)
* A self\-starter mentality, able to work independently while staying connected to team goals
* Willingness to travel up to 60% for in\-person client engagement (in region/local travel)

jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

**Company Overview**



Founded in 2004, Applied Biological Materials (abm) Inc. is a global leader in cell biology and cell engineering, leveraging advanced technologies and model systems including CRISPR gene editing, iPSC technologies, and advanced cell models to support groundbreaking discoveries in Life Sciences and Drug Development. Our headquarters in Vancouver, Canada, spans over 30,000 sq. ft. of state\-of\-the\-art wet lab and office space, serving as a hub for advanced R\&D and global logistics. Based in Canada, abm operates internationally with locations in the United States, China, and France, serving academic, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, government, and research customers worldwide.

 **About the Role**



As part of our continued expansion in the United States, abm is looking for a **Sales Account Manager** to manage and grow our **U.S. West Territory**, with a West Coast base location preferred. This role is responsible for managing and expanding existing customer accounts and developing new relationships across academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions.



You will act as a key point of contact for customers in the region, identifying needs, proposing tailored solutions, and driving business growth. The ideal candidate will bring both sales expertise and a strong understanding of the life sciences sector, with a proactive, customer\-first mindset. Experience selling **cell lines, cell\-based products, or related life science research products** is strongly preferred.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage and expand customer accounts across the U.S. West Territory, including key life science hubs and academic, biotech, pharma, CRO, government, and research institutions
* Identify new business opportunities and drive revenue growth
* Build long\-term relationships with researchers, laboratory leaders, procurement contacts, and other key decision\-makers and influencers.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, both virtually and in person, to understand research needs and identify opportunities for abm products and services.
* Develop territory and account plans, prioritize high\-potential customers, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Identify customer needs and work with internal technical and product teams to recommend appropriate solutions.
* Meet or exceed assigned revenue targets, sales KPIs, and territory growth objectives.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and activity information in the CRM system.
* Collaborate closely with Technical Support, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and other internal teams to provide a strong customer experience.
* Represent abm at regional conferences, trade shows, scientific meetings, and other customer\-facing events.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity and provide feedback to support commercial strategy.
* Travel regularly within the assigned territory for customer meetings, conferences, and events, with occasional travel to other abm locations as required.

  


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is an asset.
* Minimum **2 years of experience in business development, account management, or technical sales within the life sciences or biotechnology sector**.
* Strong understanding of the U.S. life science research, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical markets.
* Experience selling **cell lines, primary cells, cell\-based products, research reagents, or related life science products** is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing customers within the Western U.S. and/or an established customer network in the region is an asset.
* Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships, identify sales opportunities, and grow revenue.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Self\-motivated and organized, with the ability to independently manage a geographic territory and competing priorities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, growth\-oriented environment.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.

* This is a **remote position**, with **California preferred**

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About Saber Foundation Repair**

**Three Decades of Service**


Saber was born in 1987 as an innovative concrete and foundation business with a goal of providing fast service and unsurpassed quality for our customers.

  

For more than 30 years, that philosophy continues to remain at the core of our business. Our track record of delivering service and quality has enabled us to obtain coveted certifications to install the finest manufactured products in the industry; however, the accolades from Saber customers are what we value most.

  

Saber carries a long tradition of leadership and innovation in the foundation repair industry. Since we opened our doors, the company has continued to expand its already comprehensive product and service line to meet each and every client’s problem within the home.


From foundation leveling and underpinning to concrete raising, our company is sure to have the solution and experience for your foundation.

  

Saber is privately\-owned and family operated and we take your trust seriously and truly value your business. Saber now offers services throughout Southern California from Los Angeles and Santa Ana to San Diego and Long Beach.

  

We're on a mission to redefine the industry. That's why we are proud to be a part of Thrasher Partners.

 **Step Into a High\-Impact Sales Career and Join Our Mission to Redefine Our Industry**


If you're wired to win, perform best when the bar is high, and want a role where outcomes define success, we want you. At Saber Foundation Repair, we're setting a new standard in an industry that has settled for mediocre for too long. We keep our word and deliver real solutions that protect homeowners and elevate the profession.

**The Role**


As an Outside Sales Representative, you will:

* Meet with pre\-qualified homeowners, (no cold\-calling). Each of our homeowners asked for your expertise, (no wasted time).
* Use our proven diagnostic process to efficiently identify issues and get them resolved.
* Lead decisive, high\-clarity conversations that drive partnership between you and the homeowner.
* Do what's right, not what's easy. Bring excellence to every homeowner, every time.

**Why High Performers Choose Saber Foundation Repair**

* Uncapped earning potential: *our top reps consistently earn $200k–$260k\+*
* High autonomy: *focus on closing, not prospecting*
* Serious growth: *we invest in developing leaders and promoting from within*
* Mission with momentum: *we’re redefining an industry, not maintaining one*
* Full benefits: *Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with 5% match, HSA and more*

**Who You Are**

* Competitive, driven, and energized by goals and results.
* Charismatic, persuasive, and comfortable steering high\-stakes conversations.
* Sharp and able to follow a proven playbook while adapting in real time.
* At your best when the bar is high, the pace is fast, and the rewards match the effort.
* Motivated by impact, income, and the satisfaction of earning big.
* Sales experience is helpful but not required. We're more focused on mindset, coachability, and work ethic\- we'll teach the rest.


If you’re ready to join a team where decisiveness, ambition, and influence translate to real results and real compensation, the opportunity is right in front of you.


Are you ready?

*Saber Foundation Repair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment offers are contingent upon successful background checks. Employment history, education, and other relevant information may be verified during the hiring process.*

jobs.title: Social Media Manager & Lead Generation Specialist
jobs.description:
Social Media Manager \& Lead Generation SpecialistAbout the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled **Social Media Manager \& Lead Generation Specialist** to join our growing team. This is a hands\-on position for someone who understands that social media is not just about posting content it is a lead\-generation and revenue\-driving channel.

The ideal candidate is an expert in generating high\-volume leads through social media, paid advertising, organic content, and targeted campaigns. You should be comfortable managing multiple platforms, creating professional content from start to finish, running Meta advertising campaigns, analyzing performance, and continuously finding ways to increase lead volume and engagement.

This is an in\-office, full\-time position for someone who is creative, analytical, highly organized, and results\-driven.

Key Responsibilities

**Lead Generation \& Digital Marketing**

* Develop and execute strategies designed to generate a high volume of qualified leads.
* Create and manage lead\-generation campaigns across social media and digital platforms.
* Build, launch, monitor, and optimize **Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns**.
* Test different ads, audiences, offers, messaging, and creative to improve performance.
* Track lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rates, engagement, and campaign performance.
* Identify opportunities to increase lead flow through both paid and organic marketing.
* Work closely with the sales team to ensure leads are being generated with quality and volume in mind.

Social Media Management

* Developing and maintaining a consistent social media content calendar.
* Creating and publishing engaging content across platforms.
* Growing audience reach, engagement, and brand awareness.
* Monitoring comments, messages, trends, and audience interactions.
* Researching current social media trends and identifying opportunities to increase reach.
* Repurposing content across multiple platforms while adapting it to each platform's format and audience.
* Maintaining a professional and consistent brand image.

Content Creation \& Video Editing

You should be comfortable with:

* Canva — advanced/professional level
* Professional graphic design
* Video editing
* Short\-form video creation
* Reels and TikToks
* Motion graphics and animation
* Text animation
* Transitions and effects
* Captions/subtitles

Experience with professional editing software such as **Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, CapCut Pro, or similar platforms** is highly preferred.

Analytics \& Optimization

* Monitor social media and advertising performance.
* Analyze which campaigns and content are generating the strongest results.
* Track key metrics including leads, cost per lead, reach, engagement, video views, click\-through rates, and conversions.
* Make data\-driven adjustments to improve campaign performance.
* Provide regular reporting on lead generation and social media performance.

What We're Looking For

This position is best suited for someone who can say **YES** to most of the following:

* Proven experience generating leads through social media and digital advertising.
* Strong experience with Meta Ads Manager.
* Demonstrated ability to generate high\-volume leads.
* Advanced Canva skills.
* Strong video editing skills.
* Experience creating Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, and short\-form content.
* Experience with animation and motion graphics.
* Strong understanding of social media algorithms, trends, and content strategy.
* Experience managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.
* Strong copywriting and ability to write compelling hooks and calls\-to\-action.
* Understanding of paid advertising, targeting, retargeting, and audience development.
* Ability to analyze campaign data and make strategic adjustments.
* Highly creative but also highly analytical.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Able to work independently and take ownership of projects.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.

**Schedule Requirements**

* Full\-time, In\-office position
* Monday–Friday
* 8:30 AM–5:00 PM

**Work Location:** In person

**Bringing a Portfolio or examples of previous work to interviews are strongly encouraged.**

**Parking Information for interviews:** Please be aware that parking in the structure is not validated. Street parking is available nearby, and we encourage applicants to plan accordingly.

Pay: $1,200\.00 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* Lead generation: 1 year (Preferred)
* Social media management: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Hospital and community outreach biz dev specialist with strong digital marketing expertise too
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a experienced residential care facility business development representative with very strong Los Angeles hospital case management/social worker contacts and deep experise with social media management and brand development. You will be performing hospital outreach and community clinic outreach for our psychiatric residential programs in Los Angeles. The program treats both Medi\-Cal and privately insured patients who are stepping down from a psychiatric hospitalization or need a higher level of care from an outpatient setting. For this role, you will need to establish strong contacts with case management / social work discharge teams at various hospitals in the L.A. County area and visit them in person. You will also meet with outpatient programs who could use our services to step up their clients to our higher level of care. Your goal is to establish a referral network from these L.A. based hospitals and outpatient programs. About Hollywood Park  

  

Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300\-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed\-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world\-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.
  

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3\.1 million\-square\-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor\-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record\-breaking concerts. SoFi Stadium is set to host the Super Bowl LXI in 2027, the Olympic and Paralympic Opening Ceremonies for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (LA28\), along with being converted into the largest Olympic swimming venue in history.
Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2\.5\-acre open\-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000\-seat YouTube Theater. As an intimate, state\-of\-the\-art venue, YouTube Theater hosts a diverse line\-up of chart\-topping superstars, iconic comedy acts, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, and corporate conferences. Named the “Top West Coast Club or Theater” by Billboard, YouTube Theater is a must\-play destination.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boule

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Creating a world where pets live longer, healthier lives, from their very first meal.
 ### **Learn more about our brands.**

**We're Looking For A(n):** Executive Assistant


**Location:** Onsite (Burbank/North Hollywood, CA)


**What You'll Be Doing:** The Executive Assistant will serve as the executive's right hand, increasing their effective capacity by organizing time, attention, commitments, information, and the working environment around the highest\-value priorities. This role will provide traditional executive support across calendar management, scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, coordination, and follow\-through, while also taking broad ownership of the day\-to\-day operation of a new office and studio.  

  

This is a highly proactive, ownership\-oriented role responsible for creating structure where it does not yet exist, building repeatable processes, coordinating people and projects through changing information, and continuously reducing operational friction. The role will also leverage technology, AI, and automation to make work faster, more reliable, and less dependent on manual effort or individual memory.  

  

The scope of the role will evolve over time. The expectation is that the Executive Assistant will anticipate needs, exercise independent judgment, identify and resolve issues, and build systems that allow the executive and broader operation to function more effectively with less direct intervention.


* Manage the executive's calendar, priorities, scheduling, travel, and logistics.
* Prepare for meetings and ensure decisions, commitments, and open items are tracked through completion.
* Coordinate internal and external communications, meetings, people, and projects on behalf of the executive.
* Manage day\-to\-day office and studio operations, ensuring the environment is organized, functional, and ready to support ongoing business activities.
* Support the development and buildout of the new office and studio, including vendors, timelines, logistics, technology, physical\-space needs, and other operational requirements.
* Select, coordinate, and manage vendors and external partners as needed.
* Oversee office supplies, equipment, technology, and recurring operational needs.
* Coordinate guest, meeting, and other office/studio logistics.
* Build and maintain workflows, checklists, documentation, and operating processes where needed.
* Identify recurring operational friction and address the underlying process rather than repeatedly solving the same issue.
* Maintain systems for information, documents, contacts, decisions, and follow\-up.


Use AI, automation, and other technology to simplify repetitive, information\-heavy, or rules\-based work.  

* Ensure decisions are translated into action and that actions are completed.
* Identify what requires executive attention versus what can be handled independently, escalating appropriately when needed.
* Take on additional responsibilities as the needs of the executive, office, and studio evolve.


**Qualifications (Note: We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't tick ALL of these boxes.):**


* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
* Strong ownership mentality with a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach.
* Highly anticipatory; able to think downstream and identify needs, dependencies, risks, and follow\-up before they become urgent.
* Process\-oriented with a continuous\-improvement mindset; able to identify inefficient or overly manual processes and build better ways of working.
* Strong independent judgment and ability to determine when issues can be handled independently versus escalated.
* High processing speed and ability to synthesize fragmented information from multiple sources into clear priorities, decisions, and actions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly as needs and circumstances change.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across people, teams, vendors, and external partners.
* Comfortable providing and receiving direct feedback, challenging priorities when appropriate, and surfacing contradictions or issues.
* Strong discretion and judgment when handling sensitive business and personal information.
* Service\-oriented, practical, and persistent, without being passive or overly dependent on direction.
* Comfortable experimenting with modern technology, AI tools, automation, and custom workflows to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Ambitious and curious, with an interest in learning how the broader business operates and taking on increasing responsibility over time.



Required Experience:2\+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or a related role


**Golden Perks \& Benefits:**
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage – We cover **100% of premiums** for medical, dental, and vision plans for employee\-only plans.
* Annual bonus
* We match up to **3\.5% of your 401k contributions**, ensuring your retirement savings grow alongside your career.
* **6 paid sick and mental health days,** an Employee Assistance Program, free weekly yoga and meditation classes, and additional mental health benefits, because we take a holistic approach to your well\-being.
* Invest in your future with our **Employee Stock Ownership Plan**, where company contributions fund your retirement plan with company stock. Learn more.
* **Reimbursements for a portion of personal cell phone and internet usage** for eligible employees.
* **Professional development** **opportunities** with mentorship, continuous learning programs, and performance\-based pay increases, empowering you to progress and excel in your career.
* Through our charity sponsorships, you can make a positive impact on communities worldwide. We've donated over **$9 million** to date.
* Potential for quarterly KPI bonuses.


The base salary range is $30hr\-$37\.50hr, plus

**FULL\-TIME AND EXEMPT**  


This is a hybrid position, working two days per week at Linc's corporate office in Long Beach, CA.  


Please note: The position title and salary range will be determined based on the selected candidate’s skill set and level of experience.

The hiring range for the Associate is: $77,768 to $91,492

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News \& World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second\-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  

  

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.
The UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR) is driven to improve health and wellness of people in Orange County and the world by providing life\-saving clinical trials designed to strengthen and accelerate the pathway of discovery from the medical laboratory to the clinic.  


Responsibilities:

Independently or under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, and the Assistant Director of Clinical Research Operations, the incumbent leads the day\-to\-day execution of assigned clinical trials in the UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR). Serving as primary coordinator on trials of varying complexity, the incumbent is accountable for accurate execution, documentation, and communication for comprehensive coordination and data management of complex phase I – IV clinical research protocols from initiation through close\-out of research projects with human subjects. The incumbent operates in an interdisciplinary model across multiple therapeutic areas. This position facilitates all implementation phases of new clinical research studies as well as the ongoing coordination and maintenance of open and closed studies. Incumbent will conduct interviews with study patients in the clinic, screen participants, facilitate patient care, and collect data in compliance with established study protocols. The incumbent will receive appropriate onboarding and training to ensure proper preparation for this role as well as ongoing training where appropriate.
  

  

Develop and establish process for review and oversight of clinical trials conducted by investigators and ensure study protocols are followed, appropriate documentation is kept, and accurate data is collected according to Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, internal standard operating procedures (SOPs), FDA regulations, and University policies and procedures. This position plays a key role in assisting the Principal Investigator (PI) in recruiting patients for clinical studies and meeting enrollment and retention goals.
  

  

Complete timely and accurate collection and coordination of data submission to study sponsors ensuring quality control and leading to timely milestone payments. This includes responsibility for the compilation and transcription of research patient data and study\-related information into case report forms (CRFs) into sponsor specific electronic data capture systems (EDC). S/he will work with the clinical research team to manage and collect accurate data and assist Principal Investigators and study coordinators for all data management aspects of non\-cancer related trials.
  

  

The incumbent is also responsible for maintaining communication with all elements of a multi\-level research network, interacting with sponsoring agencies and compliance and regulatory groups such as the Institutional Review Board (IRB), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and sponsor monitors. This individual will interact with subjects, clinic and research staff, laboratory staff, radiology staff and any other medical professionals associated with our clinical research protocols. In addition, this individual must maintain clinical trial information in the clinical trial management system (OnCore) and adhere to institutional policies.
  

  

The main CCR offices and clinics are located at the UCI Medical Center in Orange and the UCI campus in Irvine, as well as various clinics at community sites throughout Orange County. The incumbent will be required to work at both main locations in Orange and Irvine, and sometimes community sites depending on responsibilities and scheduling demands.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
