jobs.title: Resolution Account Manager
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN TAXRISE?  


At TaxRise, we don't just provide tax relief services; we provide hope, stability, and solutions to individuals and families facing financial uncertainty. Our team is passionate about reshaping the tax resolution industry through innovation, empathy, and unwavering commitment to our clients.  


Join us and make a tangible difference in people's lives while growing your career with a team that values your contributions.  


ABOUT THE ROLE  


The Case Manager III works directly alongside our Enrolled Agents to help move complex and time\-sensitive tax resolution cases toward successful outcomes.  


While our Enrolled Agents focus on developing resolution strategies and negotiating with the IRS and state taxing authorities, the Resolution Account Manager provides critical case support by communicating with clients, obtaining urgent or additional documentation, coordinating next steps, and ensuring the Enrolled Agents have everything needed to effectively advocate for the client.  


This role will frequently support cases requiring additional attention or urgency, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners. You'll assist with these cases by communicating with the appropriate IRS contacts, tracking requests and deadlines, coordinating required documentation, and keeping the Enrolled Agent informed of important case developments.  


You'll serve as an important connection between the client, the Enrolled Agent, and taxing authorities, helping translate case needs into clear action items and keeping cases moving when timing matters most.  


We're all about that in\-person vibe, so this role is 100% on\-site! If you're excited to work side\-by\-side with our team (or are ready to make the move), then you're a perfect fit. If not, we kindly ask you to hold off on applying. Thanks for understanding and happy job hunting!  


HOW YOU'LL BE REWARDED  


At Tax Rise, Inc., we recognize and reward high performance, ownership, and results.  


Base pay: $24\.00 \- 25\.00 per hour  
Monthly Bonus: Average bonus potential of $1,000 \- $1,500  


Full\-time \| 40 hours per week. Occasional overtime may be required based on business needs.  


WHAT YOU'LL DO  


Enrolled Agents \& Case Support:  


Partner directly with assigned Enrolled Agents to support active tax resolution cases.  
Review case needs and prioritize client outreach based on deadlines, urgency, and direction from the Enrolled Agent.  
Assist with managing priority and time\-sensitive cases, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners.  
Communicate directly with Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners, as appropriate, to provide requested documentation, obtain case updates, clarify outstanding requirements, and coordinate next steps on behalf of the Enrolled Agent.  
Track IRS requests, deadlines, and follow\-up items to ensure required documentation and information are submitted timely and cases continue moving forward.  
Relay important updates, requests, and deadlines from Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners to the assigned Enrolled Agent and coordinate any necessary client follow\-up.  
Maintain clear documentation of IRS communications and escalate case developments requiring the Enrolled Agent's review, strategy, or negotiation.  


Client Communication:  


Serve as a consistent point of contact for assigned case\-related action items.  
Contact clients by phone, email, or approved communication channels to obtain additional financial and tax documentation requested by the Enrolled Agent, IRS, or state taxing authority.  
Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and applicable deadlines.  
Review incoming documentation and promptly follow up on missing or incomplete information.  


CRM Management \& Case Tracking:  


Maintain detailed and accurate CRM notes documenting client conversations, outstanding items, Enrolled Agent requests, deadlines, and case progress.  
Monitor assigned tasks and follow\-ups to ensure urgent requests are completed within required deadlines.  


WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE  


Previous experience in document coordination, loan processing, or a similar administrative role (tax\-related experience is a plus).  
Strong ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.  
Proven experience handling urgent and sensitive client situations while maintaining professionalism and composure.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex requests in an understandable way.  
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing or incomplete documentation.  
Proficiency in using CRM systems or document management tools; familiarity with tax software is a bonus.  
Strong follow\-up skills and the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through completion.  
Ability to collaborate closely with Enrolled Agents and follow case\-specific directions..  
Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while meeting deadlines.  
Knowledge of IRS and state tax documentation is a plus; additional training will be provided.  


WHAT WE OFFER  


We believe in taking care of our team so they can take care of our clients. Here's what you can expect as part of the TaxRise family:  


Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (starting after 60 days)  
Paid Time Off  
401(k) retirement plan with company match  
Professional Development Program to support your growth  
Access to our on\-site gym and gaming lounge  
Catered team lunches every Friday  
Fun and energizing quarterly company outings  


ABOUT US  


At TaxRise, our mission is simple yet impactful: to revolutionize the way taxpayers navigate their tax challenges. We believe in the power of lifting others up, and that's the driving force behind everything we do.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**



Archipelago Companies, a portfolio of highly successful consumer lifestyle brands, is seeking a talented and passionate individual with an entrepreneurial mindset to join our team. Our brands, including OluKai, Kaenon, Melin, Roark, and Tradewind Services are leaders in their respective markets, offering high\-quality products and authentic marketing stories direct to consumers. At Archipelago Companies, we pride ourselves on our commitment to integrity, and we strive to create a culture of excellence in everything we do. If you are a driven and innovative individual with a passion for consumer brands, we invite you to apply for our open position and become a part of our dynamic and growing team.

 **About the Role:**



The International Distributor Account Manager owns the day\-to\-day commercial relationship with the distributor partners who represent OluKai, Melin, and Roark outside our directly operated markets. These distributors represent our brands in their local markets (i.e. Japan, LATAM, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, etc).

  

This is a cross\-brand individual contributor role that sits within Tradewind Services and is based in our Irvine, California office. You will be the commercial and operational center of gravity for an assigned book of distributor accounts: building and defending the seasonal forecast, driving prebook and at\-once order flow, tracking sell\-in against sell\-thru, and holding partners to brand standards in every market where they carry our labels.

  

We are looking for someone equally comfortable in a line presentation and in a pivot table, who can hold a partner accountable to a number without damaging the relationship, and who understands that in a distributor model your partner’s inventory position is your problem too.

 **Key responsibilities in the following areas include but are not limited to:**

 **Distributor Account Management**


* Serve as the primary day to day contact for an assigned portfolio of international distributors across all three brands
* Run the seasonal sell\-in cycle end to end: line presentation, market\-level assortment planning, prebook collection, order entry accuracy, and confirmation
* Manage at\-once demand and in\-season replenishment against available inventory, and coordinate seasonal samples, price lists, and asset delivery to partners
* Own the order book: monitor open orders, ship windows, cancellations, and backorders, and drive on\-time delivery in partnership with Planning and Operations

  


**Forecasting and Planning**


* Build and maintain rolling seasonal forecasts by distributor, brand, and category, and reconcile them to the annual plan
* Partner with Planning and Production on demand signals, buy quantities, and inventory positioning for the International channel
* Track sell\-in against sell\-thru by partner, and flag risk to plan early with a recommended course of action rather than a report of the problem

  


**Commercial Performance**


* Own revenue, margin, and order fill targets for the assigned book of business
* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews covering performance to plan, category and product mix, sell\-thru trends, open opportunities, and corrective actions
* Support pricing, terms, and margin discipline within approved guardrails, and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation
* Partner with Credit and Finance on payment terms, credit exposure, and collections issues affecting the book

  


**Brand and Market Stewardship**


* Hold distributors to brand standards for assortment, presentation, pricing integrity, and channel distribution in their markets
* Review distributor retailer lists, marketing plans, and go to market activity against each brand’s guidelines, and route brand asset requests appropriately
* Surface market intelligence (competitive activity, retail trends, product gaps, pricing pressure) back to the brand and product teams

  


**Cross\-functional Partnership**


* Work daily with Planning, Production, Operations, Customer Service, Credit, and the three brand teams to keep the distributor experience seamless
* Partner with Logistics and trade compliance resources on export documentation, freight, incoterms, and country specific requirements
* Contribute the International point of view to seasonal go to market and range planning

  


**Requirements \& Qualifications:**

  

* Four or more years in wholesale account management, international sales, or distributor management, in consumer products. Footwear, apparel, headwear, or an adjacent premium lifestyle category is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ownership of a revenue book with personal accountability for forecast accuracy and delivery to plan
* Working command of the wholesale seasonal calendar and how prebook, at\-once, sell\-in, and sell\-thru each move the order book
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets) and the ability to build a forecast you can defend line by line
* Experience operating in an ERP and a BI or reporting environment, and the judgment to move from raw order data to a clear recommendation
* Clear, organized written and verbal communication with partners across time zones, languages, and business cultures
* Actively seeks out AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies, adapting quickly to leverage them for improved productivity, deeper insights, and more effective processes, while exercising sound judgment and maintaining compliance with organizational standards
* A valid passport and the ability to travel internationally

  


**Preferred Experience**


* Direct experience managing distributor relationships, as distinct from direct wholesale accounts
* Familiarity with export logistics, incoterms, customs documentation, and international trade compliance
* Professional working proficiency in a second language
* Experience with Full Circle, Domo, or comparable ERP and BI platforms

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R\&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross\-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  




**Duties/Responsibilities:**



* Collect, track, and maintain project\-related data, including schedules, manufacturing progress, and status updates.


* Prepare routine project reports, dashboards, and summaries to support Project Managers and Program Managers.


* Follow up with internal departments (e.g., Engineering, Production, Quality, Supply Chain) to gather required information and resolve data gaps.


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation, ensuring records are complete and properly organized.


* Support coordination of internal meetings by preparing agendas, capturing action items, and tracking follow\-ups.


* Assist with monitoring project milestones and highlighting potential schedule risks or delays to the PM team.


* Support administrative and analytical tasks related to project execution, resource tracking, and process improvement efforts.


* Ensure project information is delivered accurately and on time to support effective decision\-making.


**Required Skills/Abilities:** **(Example of skills set)**



* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.


* High attention to detail to ensure accuracy of data, reports, and documentation.


* Effective written and verbal communication skills for internal coordination and reporting.


* Basic analytical skills with the ability to compile, organize, and interpret project data.


* Proficiency with common office and collaboration tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, project tracking systems).


* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional, fast\-paced manufacturing or engineering environment.


* Proactive and reliable work style with the ability to follow through on assigned tasks and deadlines.


**Education and Experience:**



* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field preferred.


* Entry\-level experience or internships in project coordination, manufacturing, operations, or administrative support are beneficial but not required.

jobs.title: NorthWest Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
SALES COORDINATOR – NORTHWEST

Location: San Francisco / Bay Area (Home\-Based)  
Territory: Washington, Oregon, Northern California, and surrounding markets

About EX NIHILO

Founded in Paris, EX NIHILO is a contemporary French luxury fragrance house redefining modern perfumery through creativity, innovation, and uncompromising craftsmanship. Inspired by the spirit of bespoke luxury, EX NIHILO creates exceptional olfactory experiences through personalization, artistic collaborations, and a commitment to excellence.

As one of the fastest\-growing luxury fragrance houses, EX NIHILO partners with the world's most prestigious retailers while remaining true to its entrepreneurial spirit and Parisian heritage.

Position Overview

EX NIHILO is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and relationship\-driven Sales Coordinator to support the growth and execution of the brand across the Northwest.

Based in the San Francisco or Bay area, this role will work closely with the Regional Account Executive and National Sales team to support retail partners, maximize sales opportunities, and ensure exceptional execution across the territory.

The Sales Coordinator will support account management, sales initiatives, events, education, merchandising, vendor relationships, and the recruitment and development of Store Ambassadors. This is an ideal opportunity for a polished luxury professional who is passionate about fragrance, commercially minded, and eager to grow within a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial organization.

Key Responsibilities

Sales \& Account Support

* Support the Regional Sales Manager in managing and growing retail business across the Northwest.
* Monitor sales performance, sell\-through, inventory, and productivity across assigned doors.
* Support account business plans, new door openings, launches, events, and key commercial initiatives.
* Prepare sales reports, recaps, and business updates.
* Identify opportunities and challenges and communicate actionable insights to the Regional Sales Manager.

Retail Relationship Management

* Build strong relationships with store leadership, beauty managers, fragrance specialists, personal shoppers, and top\-selling associates.
* Serve as a consistent field contact for assigned retail partners.
* Conduct regular store visits to assess sales performance, team engagement, inventory, merchandising, and brand presentation.
* Support market appointments and retail business meetings.

Store Ambassador \& Talent Management

* Support the recruitment and selection of high\-performing Store Ambassadors and field talent.
* Help identify and attract top talent aligned with EX NIHILO's luxury standards and commercial objectives.
* Support interviewing, onboarding, scheduling, training, and ongoing development of Store Ambassadors.
* Manage day\-to\-day communication and field coordination with Ambassadors.
* Monitor performance, provide feedback, and recognize opportunities to develop and retain top talent.

Vendor \& Field Partner Management

* Manage relationships with third\-party vendors and field partners supporting the Midwest business.
* Coordinate staffing, events, merchandising, and other field initiatives.
* Ensure vendors consistently execute EX NIHILO brand standards and deliver against expectations.
* Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and communicate operational needs to internal teams.

Client Experience \& Education

* Support in\-store events, VIP activations, fragrance experiences, and clienteling initiatives.
* Coordinate event logistics, staffing, product, POSM, and post\-event recaps.
* Support product knowledge and selling trainings in partnership with the Education team.
* Help ensure retail teams and Store Ambassadors are engaged around launches, product storytelling, and commercial priorities.

Merchandising \& Operations

* Conduct regular store visits to ensure brand standards, merchandising, testers, POSM, and product presentation are maintained.
* Communicate inventory, operational, and merchandising needs to internal teams.
* Support new door openings, launches, renovations, and visual merchandising initiatives.
* Maintain accurate account, staffing, calendar, and field activity information.

Cross\-Functional \& Market Support

* Partner with Sales, Education, Marketing, Operations, and Headquarters to ensure seamless execution of initiatives.
* Monitor competitive activity and luxury fragrance trends within the Midwest.
* Share market insights, consumer feedback, and retailer opportunities with the Regional Account Executive and National Sales team.

Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in luxury beauty, fragrance, fashion, or prestige retail.
* Experience with luxury department stores, specialty retailers, or independent fragrance boutiques.
* Experience coordinating Brand Ambassadors, vendors, freelancers, or field teams preferred.
* Strong ability to build relationships and identify high\-performing talent.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
* Strong understanding of luxury retail and exceptional client service.
* Comfortable analyzing sales data and retail performance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently in a home\-based role.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout the Northwest territory.

Preferred Attributes

* Passion for luxury fragrance, beauty, craftsmanship, and exceptional client experiences.
* Polished and sophisticated professional presence.
* Natural ability to identify, attract, and develop top talent.
* Highly organized, proactive, and resourceful.
* Commercially minded with strong attention to detail.
* Collaborative, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable holding partners accountable.
* Entrepreneurial spirit and enthusiasm for a high\-growth luxury organization.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive base salary
* Performance\-based bonus opportunity
* Medical benefits
* Paid

jobs.description:
**About the Team**

You will be part of a collaborative team responsible for creating elevated imagery to showcase our new and signature products. As part of Williams\-Sonoma, Inc., a leader in home lifestyle and retail, The Sample Coordinator is part of a Photo Team that drives customer engagement and profitability through compelling visual storytelling.  

**About the Role**

In this role, you will be responsible for organizing, transporting, and staging merchandise, props, surfaces, grip, crafty, and other supplies necessary to efficiently execute each shoot. You will be relied on by the Producer for any updates regarding product issues, supply shortages, equipment and truck maintenance, etc. We are seeking someone who is a self\-starter, detail\-oriented, and able to work independently and proactively to constantly support all facets of our photo teams while maintaining a can\-do attitude.


**Duties \+ Responsibilities:**

* Work with Producers daily to review what’s needed to execute photoshoots including — ordering and organizing merchandise and props, prepping surfaces, equipment, and crafty items.
* Understand the sample ordering/returning process to help organize and track merchandise before and after photoshoots.
* Unpack and carefully re\-pack photo samples safely for transit between photo teams, WS buildings, locations, and the warehouse.
* Unpack, check in, and test (if applicable) product before each shoot.
  

Save/organize paperwork/empty boxes, alert Producers of any issues with product, and note quantity received on sample tracker.

* Unload and reload trucks with merchandise.
Maintain a professional and respectful demeanor with the photo team, merchants, vendors, and homeowners.  
*

* Extremely organized and thorough – you’re able to stage samples thoughtfully, troubleshooting samples for anything missing, broken, or defective and alerting Producers immediately.
* Anticipate needs – you’re always two steps ahead, listening so you can foresee and resolve issues early.
* Maintain an “all hands\-on deck” mentality to jump in to help where needed.
Sense of urgency when the task calls for it.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2\-4 years of related experience working as production assistant on photoshoot sets
* A high school diploma required
* Experience and ability to drive large trucks
* Must have a valid driver’s license \& satisfactory driving record
* Willing to complete a driver training program and participate in DMV’s employer pull notice program
* Must be able to lift and move merchandise up to 75 pounds
* Understanding of proper lifting techniques
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Detail\-oriented and self\-motivated
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
Ability to work in office and perform in corporate environment  
* 

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to lift up to 75 pounds
  

This is a very physically demanding role, and you will be expected to lift heavy items daily
* Ability to sit and stand for prolonged periods of time
* Ability to type on computer
* Ability to talk and text on a cell phone
Ability to work in office and perform in corporate environment  
* 
**Our Culture \& Values**

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing. Our associates are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work, so they can be their best and achieve their personal and professional goals. We make inclusivity a cornerstone of our culture by welcoming associates with diverse cultures and backgrounds and celebrating them, together. We nurture an open, inclusive environment for all. Our differences—whatever they may be—are valued, explored, and appreciated. Together, we’re creating a more just and inclusive company culture where the only criteria for advancement are:


* The quality of our work

Our ability to lead and connect

We firmly believe that working in a culture focused on diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) spurs innovation, creates healthy and high\-performing teams, and delivers superior customer experiences. Outside of WSI, we recognize the importance of playing a part in our communities through partnerships, collaborations, and commitments to a more just and inclusive world.

WeBox is the leading intelligent marketplace delivering personalized group orders.  

WeBox is driven by three core principles: customers first, value the strivers, and build with partners.

  

### **Our Mission and Vision**


WeBox strives to deliver personalized group orders, ensuring that every group member enjoys the happiness of delivery.By 2032, we will achieve $1 billion in revenue by leveraging technology to become a leading provider of intelligent and sustainable solutions for group orders.

WeBox, the leading intelligent marketplace for personalized group orders, is seeking a proactive and resourceful Logistics Operations Coordinator to join our team. **Social Media Coordinator (Independent Contractor)** 

**About The Pearl**

The Pearl is a premier private event venue in San Francisco's Dogpatch neighborhood. Known for its modern design, rooftop garden, and immersive art installations, The Pearl hosts everything from corporate gatherings and weddings to galas and creative productions. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences, blending hospitality, creativity, and seamless event execution.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Social Media Coordinator (independent contractor) to run The Pearl's Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest. We set the goals and brand direction; you deliver the content.

**Platform management and strategy**

* 2 posts per week on each of Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest, scheduled via Later.com.

* Collaborate with the marketing team on fresh content ideas and campaign concepts.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience managing social accounts with measurable results — please share the accounts you've run and what you grew. Links required.

* Strong familiarity with Instagram, Pinterest and TikTok best practices, including current format and algorithm behavior.

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

jobs.description:
Health Link Home Health \& Hospice  
Milpitas / Santa Clara County, CA  
Full\-Time \| $41/hour \+ Performance\-Based Bonus  


The Role  


For over 20 years, Health Link Home Health \& Hospice has served patients throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We are seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Account Manager to join our Community Relations team and support continued growth throughout Santa Clara County.  


Working closely with the Director of Business Development, the Account Manager will focus on developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare providers, increasing awareness of Health Link's home health services, and generating new referral opportunities throughout the South Bay.  


This is a field\-based role for someone who enjoys building relationships, connecting with healthcare professionals, and developing business within the community. We are looking for someone who is motivated, consistent, organized, and comfortable being accountable for growth goals.  


You will be supported with a company vehicle, ongoing training, and AI\-powered technology designed to provide referral insights and support efficient territory routing.  


What You'll Do  
Develop and maintain referral relationships throughout assigned areas of Santa Clara County  
Build relationships with hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, physicians, medical groups, clinics, senior living communities, and other healthcare organizations  
Conduct consistent in\-person outreach, account visits, meetings, presentations, and follow\-up  
Introduce new healthcare partners to Health Link and educate them on our home health services, clinical programs, and capabilities  
Maintain regular communication with existing referral partners and strengthen those relationships over time  
Identify new referral opportunities through consistent field outreach and relationship building  
Follow up with prospective referral partners and maintain consistent account contact  
Execute territory priorities and business development initiatives in partnership with the Director of Business Development  
Communicate feedback from referral partners, market activity, and potential growth opportunities to the Director of Business Development  
Collaborate with Intake, Clinical, Operations, and other internal teams to support a strong referral and patient experience  
Meet established referral, admission, and account growth goals  
Represent Health Link professionally throughout the South Bay healthcare community  
What You'll Need  
1\+ year of experience in healthcare sales, business development, account management, community relations, or a related healthcare role preferred  
Strong relationship\-building and communication skills  
Sales\-oriented mindset with the motivation to develop new business and grow referral relationships  
Comfortable conducting in\-person outreach and developing new professional relationships  
Strong follow\-up, organization, and time\-management skills  
Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in the field  
Knowledge of the Santa Clara County healthcare market preferred  
Existing relationships within the South Bay healthcare community are a plus  
Home health, hospice, post\-acute care, senior care, hospital, or skilled nursing experience preferred  
Valid California driver's license and driving record that meets company requirements  
Benefits  
Performance\-based bonus opportunity  
Company vehicle  
AI\-powered technology to support referral insights and efficient territory routing  
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance  
401(k) with company matching  
Paid time off

Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.

**Who We Are**

**ITAV** is a sports\-based youth development organization that uses sports, fitness, structured play, and engaging activities to help young people build confidence, communication skills, leadership, accountability, and positive relationships.

We believe kids learn some of life's most important lessons while they're moving, playing, competing, communicating, and having fun.

What You'll Be Doing

As a **Program Coordinator – Recess Coach**, you'll help bring energy, structure, and FUN to the school day.

**You'll:**

* Lead fun, age\-appropriate sports, games, and movement activities.
* Get students excited about participating — including kids who may not usually join in.
* Encourage teamwork, communication, sportsmanship, and fair play.
* Help students build confidence and leadership skills through play.
* Help students work through disagreements and practice healthy conflict resolution.
* Create an environment where every child feels welcomed and included.
* Actively supervise students and keep activities safe, organized, and engaging.
* Adapt games and activities to support students with different abilities and needs.
* Build positive relationships with teachers, school staff, students, and the ITAV team.
* Respond appropriately to student concerns, injuries, incidents, or unexpected situations.
* Support field days, special events, after\-school activities, and other ITAV programs when needed.

**You'll Be Great at This If You...**

* Genuinely enjoy working with children and young people.
* Bring positive energy into a room — or onto a playground!
* Aren't afraid to jump into a game and participate.
* Can confidently lead and engage groups of children.
* Know how to be fun **and** maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Are patient, dependable, responsible, and professional.
* Communicate well with children and adults.
* Can stay calm when things don't go exactly as planned.
* Believe every child should have an opportunity to participate and feel successful.
* Enjoy being part of a team.

What We're Looking For

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience working with children or youth.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead games, activities, and groups of students.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Dependability and punctuality.
* Ability to work in active indoor and outdoor environments.

**Even Better If You Have:**

* Experience as a coach, camp counselor, recreation specialist, group leader, school aide, paraprofessional, or after\-school instructor.
* Experience working with students with disabilities or behavioral support needs.
* Sports, fitness, recreation, or youth development experience.
* Knowledge of positive behavior management or conflict\-resolution strategies.
* CPR or First Aid certification.

**This Role Is Active!**

You won't spend your day sitting behind a desk.

You'll be walking, moving, demonstrating games, setting up activities, interacting with students, and spending time indoors and outdoors.

If you enjoy an active workday, this may be a great fit.

**Why Join ITAV?**

Because **recess is more than free time.**

It's where kids can learn to communicate.

It's where they practice teamwork.

It's where confidence grows.

It's where new friendships happen.

And sometimes, it's where a young person discovers that they're a leader.

At ITAV, you'll have an opportunity to make those moments happen every day.

Ready to Bring the Energy?

If you're ready to **move, motivate, mentor, and make an impact**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help ITAV create playgrounds and programs where every child has an opportunity to play, connect, grow, and thrive!**

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
* 559728

* Job Type: Support Staff \- Union
* Bargaining Unit: Local 2110
* Regular/Temporary: Regular

* Hours Per Week: 20

* Building: Pulitzer Hall
* Salary Range: $33\.45/hr. \- $35\.72/hr.

*The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to departmental budgets, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, specialty, and training. The above hiring range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.*  

Position Summary


This part\-time administrative position will support both Columbia Journalism Review (CJR) and The Brown Institute (Brown).


The Program Coordinator will work closely with the Deputy Director, Brown Institute to carry out the institute's goals, with primary responsibility for the administration of finances and event logistics.


They will also work to support CJR’s mission, primarily through the administration of the publication’s finances and other administrative and logistical work.


The Brown Institute is a unique, bicoastal partnership between Columbia Journalism School (CJS) and Stanford’s School of Engineering. It was founded with a gift from Helen Gurley Brown (HGB) in 2012, and offers grants and development support for original work crossing journalism, media and technology. Each year, the Columbia and Stanford sides of the institute together award over $1M to help teams “follow their passions and experiment with new approaches to storytelling,” to paraphrase Gurley Brown. Since our founding, the Institute has funded over 160 projects, supporting nearly 425 people. Some of these grants produced innovative works of journalism, others developed platforms to assist with creativity, and still others explored entirely new forms of expression.


The Columbia Journalism Review (CJR) is the intellectual leader in the rapidly changing world of journalism. Our coverage takes the form of special issues, daily articles, newsletters, podcasts, and more. The work we do is produced by a small team of staff members, including post\-graduate fellows, along with regular contractors and occasional freelancers.


This position is contingent on performance and the continued availability of funding.

  



Responsibilities


Manages financial transactions for CJR and the Brown Institute including, but not limited to, making vendor payments, processing travel expenses, issuing contracts, and managing other bills. Where applicable, creates and provides reports analyzing these expenditures, and presents these statistics to senior leadership.


Supports staff, fellows, grantees, and researchers by coordinating travel, procurement, and reimbursements.


Prepares and monitors budgets and regular status reports. Researches, analyzes, and summarizes financial activities in all accounts; oversees the reconciliation of those accounts. Be prepared for regular meetings and be responsive to emails or calls about budget\-related matters.


Responsible for financial and administrative compliance with Columbia fiscal policy and provides fiscal oversight department accounts. This includes reviewing and analyzing budgets, and identifying improvements and solutions to budget issues.


As needed, handles logistics for CJR or Brown Institute events and workshops and coordinates in\-house staff (e.g. Facilities, Audio Visual, IT) and outside vendors to develop successful events that meet budget requirements.


Serves as the point person for HR administrative issues including, but not limited to, paid time off tracking and reporting, performance appraisals, effort reporting, hiring, and onboarding.


Manages administrative aspects and day\-to\-day operations of the Brown Institute. Responds to inquiries, evaluating and categorizing accordingly, and forwarding when suitable to appropriate parties. At CJR, ensures that all billing and budget related needs are addressed such that the publication can function, responding to updates from service providers, communicating with colleagues, and participating in recurring budget meetings.


Serves as liaison to various university offices including, but not limited to, Journalism School and Central Finance, Sponsored Projects and Procurement.


Performs other related duties as assigned.

  



Minimum Qualifications


*Education:* Bachelor’s degree and/or its equivalent


*Experience:* Minimum of up to 2 years related experience


*Other:*


Ability to work independently under great pressure and to meet deadlines exercising initiative. Must be detail oriented, and be able to identify priorities within multiple assignments. Excellent customer service orientation and good communication, organization, interpersonal and writing skills are essential. Should have some research skills. Strong computer proficiency is also required. Should be able to work extended hours and weekends when events and/or conferences are scheduled.

  



Preferred Qualifications


Other Requirements

Columbia University is committed to the hiring of qualified local residents.

jobs.title: Culinary Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Schedule**: 40 hours per week, primarily weekdays, with flexibility for occasional early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event needs.


For more than 18 years, Dish Food \& Events has created memorable NYC events by pairing delicious food with Heart Hospitality. The Culinary Operations Coordinator provides the administrative coordination that keeps our events organized and production\-ready. Working closely with Sales, Culinary, and Operations, this role communicates event details, maintains accurate information in Total Party Planner and Galley, prepares event materials, and helps every team deliver an exceptional guest experience.

 **Key Responsibilities*** Partner with the Executive Chef to co\-lead Dish's weekly production meeting, and additional meetings as needed. Bring together Sales, Culinary, and Operations to align on each event's client experience and execution plan.
* Own event readiness in Total Party Planner (TPP): audit menus, guest counts, quantities, dietary needs, custom items, service style, timing, staffing, labor, rentals, equipment, packing, delivery, and on\-site setup before production deadlines.
* Document production\-meeting decisions; enter and update TPP and Galley information; confirm required tasks are complete; and follow through with Sales, Culinary, and Operations to resolve open items, data discrepancies, and entry errors.
* Maintain accurate, organized TPP and Galley records, including menu items, recipes, ingredients, yields, allergens, production notes, and custom requests. Confirm approved recipes and required details are entered before production.
* Prepare and distribute TPP reports, event\-chef binders, and related event paperwork, including event details, timelines, service notes, recipes, production guidance, and available plating or presentation photos. Ensure materials are complete, current, and sent on time; the Executive Chef remains the culinary point of contact for Event Chefs.
* Communicate approved changes to kitchen, warehouse, and logistics teams; coordinate last\-minute updates and escalate issues that could affect cost, quality, timing, or guest experience.
* Create practical checklists and workflows for order processing, recipe setup, custom\-item entry, production\-meeting follow\-up, and final event readiness. Identify ways to reduce errors, waste, rework, and last\-minute scrambling.

  

**Qualifications*** 2\+ years of administrative coordination experience in catering, food production, event operations, hospitality, or a related environment.
* Practical understanding of food production, catering logistics, and how event details affect kitchen production, warehouse packing, transport, staffing, and on\-site service.
* Experience with Total Party Planner (TPP), Galley, or similar catering and recipe\-management software preferred; ability to learn systems quickly is essential.
* Experience reading and documenting standardized recipes, including yields, ingredients, allergens, portioning, and production notes.
* Strong data\-entry skills, exceptional accuracy, organization, follow\-through, and ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and comfort working across Sales, Culinary, and Operations. Professional, collaborative, and service\-minded approach.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and spreadsheets; knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices. ServSafe certification is a plus.
* Calm, practical, solutions\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**Culture \& Core Values*** Embody Dish's Mission, Core Values, and Heart Hospitality standards in every interaction and event.
* Foster positive, proactive communication across Sales, Culinary, Operations, and the broader Dish team.
* Actively participate in Dish's Culture \& Growth Program, including regular 1:1s, check\-ins, and annual performance reviews.
* Contribute to a supportive, collaborative, and accountable work environment.

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid time off, paid holidays, paid family leave, sick pay, and short\- and long\-term disability insurance.
* 401(k) plan after 12 months of full\-time employment and commuter benefits.
* Paid Volunteer Time Off and daily family meal.

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator (Evening Shift)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:** \- We believe that everyone deserves a home!
  
  

Breaking Ground operates nearly 4,000 units of housing across New York City, along with housing in upstate New York and Connecticut. Supportive housing \- affordable housing paired with services designed to help people maintain their homes for the long\-term \- is widely recognized as a proven and cost\-effective solution to chronic homelessness.
  
  

But we didn't stop at providing housing. Breaking Ground's programs and services help people experiencing street homelessness \- especially those who have been on the streets the longest \- to come indoors. Through our Street to Home outreach program and transitional housing resources, we help people get, and stay, on the path to a permanent home.
  
  

Breaking Ground’s Street to Home program makes regular contact with more than 2,000 street homeless individuals and connects more than 500 individuals to housing, medical and mental health services, substance abuse counseling, and other essential supports each year. The caring, individually tailored attention clients receive at each stage of their journey from street to home ensures that more than 95% of people who Breaking Ground places remain stably housed.
  
  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Programs, Outreach, the Outreach Coordinator manages and supervises street outreach teams, providing coordination across the teams to ensure there is always staff deployed in the field and helps to triage and prioritize urgent requests or developing situations. The Outreach Coordinator ensures the teams utilize Harm Reduction and Housing First approaches when conducting street outreach and engage with individuals to determine homelessness history, services needed, and appropriate placement options from the field in the moment. The Outreach Coordinator creates shift schedules, ensuring continual coverage in the field, and that Housing Advocate teams are compliant with data entry requirements into DHS’ system contractual requirements.
  
  

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for gaining a holistic understanding of the homeless population and works in collaboration with the community and other partners to implement appropriate housing and service solutions. The Outreach Coordinator manages their teams’ responses to community concerns, oversees Code Red/Blue alerts, identifies new hotspots and encampments, plans weekly canvass schedules for the teams, and oversees all 9\.58 assessments and removals for the shift.
  
  

Programs staff are required to locate and assist street homeless individuals under the most extreme weather conditions. Managers are required to be in the field during Code Reds and Code Blues. Staff must be willing to engage with street homeless individuals and can handle multiple tasks in a fast paced, dynamic, team environment.
  
  

This position is primarily the evening shift and has a 35\-hour work week as well as on\-call responsibilities.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**  

Successful oversight and performance management of street outreach teams including Housing Advocates and a Team Leader II who supervises an additional street outreach team and a part time Social Worker
  
  

Provide regular, structured supervision meetings for direct reports
  
  

Responsible for implementing supervisory strategies, and systems of accountability to ensure that staff have adequate support, guidance, and oversight at all times
  
  

Create and implement shift schedules that ensure teams are deployed at all times; find coverage for callouts, vacations, and vacancies
  
  

Ensure canvassing incorporates feedback from the team, community, DHS, historical 311 data, etc
  
  

Promote effective strategies for outreach work, following Housing First, Harm Reduction, Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI), Motivational Interviewing and trauma\-informed care models of practice
  
  

Ensure adherence to program contracts, regulatory requirements, and internal guidelines, ensuring all performance targets and service delivery benchmarks are consistently met
  
  

Responsible for ensuring documentation, reporting, and referrals are accurately completed on time and in compliance with DHS and Breaking Ground requirements
  
  

Provide support and guidance to staff in managing difficult situations and successfully de\-escalating conflict
  
  

Oversee and participate in Code Blue/Red Alerts, providing clinical leadership to the teams when they encounter challenging situations
  
  

Assess and complete 9\.58 involuntary removals to a hospital and ensure all required documentation is accurate and completed on time
  
  

Serve as a liaison with community partners, intergovernmental stakeholders, DHS staff and other community stakeholders to respond to emergent concerns, including 311 calls and encampment engagement
  
  

Develop strong collaborative relationships with external partners and service providers, NYPD, EMS, etc
  
  

Attend onsite meetings with community partners
  
  

Provide on call coverage as needed for the program
  
  

Perform other duties as assigned
  
  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

NYS Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW) required
  
  

Minimum 3 years supervisory experience required
  
  

Obtain 9\.58 credentialing within first 3 months of hire required
  
  

Understanding of Housing First, client centered motivational interviewing, Harm Reduction models, behavioral and medical health systems
  
  

Experience with crisis intervention, including, risk assessments and incident management
  
  

Excellent communication skills (verbally and written) and ability to work with diverse population
  
  

Superb collaborative skills; ability to work successfully with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
  
  

Detailed oriented and can manage team tasks
  
  

Excellent scheduling skills

jobs.title: Print Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SEEN is looking for a highly organized, detail\-driven Print Production Coordinator to help bring campaigns from approved artwork to the streets.**

This role sits at the center of our print and campaign operations, coordinating artwork, production, delivery, and installation across a high volume of campaigns. You’ll work closely with our sales, operations, production, and installation teams to make sure every campaign is produced accurately, delivered on time, and installed exactly as planned.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who likes moving quickly, keeping details straight, solving problems, and seeing their work physically come to life in the city.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate print campaigns from artwork approval through production, delivery, and installation
* Review campaign specs, quantities, sizes, materials, artwork, and production requirements
* Coordinate with internal production teams, printers, installers, and vendors
* Track production schedules and campaign deadlines across multiple active projects
* Confirm artwork is properly prepared and production\-ready
* Manage print orders and ensure the correct materials and quantities are produced
* Coordinate delivery of printed materials to warehouses, installers, and job sites
* Maintain accurate campaign trackers, production schedules, and status updates
* Communicate campaign updates and potential issues to internal teams
* Identify production or scheduling issues early and help find solutions
* Work closely with installation teams to make sure the right materials arrive at the right location at the right time
* Help manage last\-minute changes, reprints, rush orders, and other real\-world campaign needs
* Keep detailed records of campaign materials, costs, deliveries, and completion
* Support post\-campaign reconciliation and reporting
* Additional duties around billboard installation and or tasks may arise during your employment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2\+ years of experience in print production, advertising, OOH, media, marketing operations, or a related field
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills and follow\-through
* Comfortable working with printers, production vendors, and internal teams
* Ability to understand print specifications, materials, quantities, and production requirements
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly
* Resourceful problem solver who doesn’t wait around for someone else to fix an issue
* Someone who takes ownership and understands that the details matter

**The SEEN Mindset**

We work in the physical world. Things have to get printed, delivered, installed, and seen.

That means this role requires someone who is comfortable getting into the details and figuring things out. You should be organized enough to keep hundreds of moving pieces straight, but practical enough to pick up the phone and solve a problem when something doesn't go according to plan.

You don't need to know everything about outdoor advertising on day one. You do need to be curious, accountable, organized, and willing to get into the work.

**About SEEN**

SEEN is an independent outdoor media company built around the streets, cities, and culture that make advertising matter.

We work directly with brands, record labels, artists, agencies, and cultural partners to bring campaigns into the physical world — from street\-level posters and barricades to billboards and large\-scale outdoor installations.

Our work is built to be seen in the places where people actually live, work, move, and play.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Open to candidates who are permanent.
  

  

The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health, and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York's most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. DOHMH is mandated to inspect 26,000 restaurants annually, school cafeterias, and mobile food vending unit, adult day care centers, senior centers, soup kitchens, homeless shelters, and other facilities.
  

  

DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Serve as a point of contact for al front\-end MFV customer service interactions, maintaining high\-quality care and effectively routing inquiries.
* Prepare and maintain various data and facility reports, logs, and tracking analyses to support informed decision\-making by the Regional Director.
* Provide customer care services through phone and in\-person interactions regarding mobile food vending permits and licenses, including guiding customers on required documentation.
* Assist in logistical planning and execution of operations, including scheduling appointments for Mobile Food Vendors pre\-permit inspections, and inventory control.
* Organize and host training sessions, ensuring designated facility space is available for administrative and custodial staff.
* Address inquiries from the Bureau’s Health \& Safety Coordinator and maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.
* Collaborate with Human Resources regarding personnel matters such as training and documentation.
* Work with the Director of Communications to ensure the facility has up\-to\-date literature and messaging for customer service needs.
* Support the Bureau’s Project Support Specialist with updates on vehicle usage and documentation.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Procurement Coordinator to monitor supplies and report any IT or resource issues.
* Assist with additional administrative duties and special projects as assigned to support the program.

  

PREFERRED SKILLS:
  

* Excellent communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Excellent decision making and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Bilingual

  

Why you should work for us:
  

  

* Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
* Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:

o a premium\-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
  

o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
  

o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  

o a tax\-deferred savings program and
  

o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
  

* Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.

\- Job Security \- you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  

  

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti\-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID\-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.
  

  

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.title: Mid-Market SaaS Account Manager
jobs.description:
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused SaaS Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.


In this role, you’ll serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your assigned accounts. You will build trusted customer relationships, understand each organization’s goals and AI strategy, increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and proactively address risks that could affect the customer experience or commercial relationship.

  

You’ll be responsible for developing and executing account plans, managing a healthy expansion pipeline, and coordinating internal teams to resolve customer needs. This includes identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across relevant products, features, use cases, and services.

  

This role is ideal for someone who combines consultative selling skills with strong account management, commercial judgment, and a genuine interest in helping customers realize measurable value from AI.

  

Responsibilities:

  

Account Ownership and Customer Relationships

* Own and actively manage a portfolio of existing customer accounts.
* Serve as the primary commercial point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
* Develop a clear understanding of each customer’s business priorities, AI strategy, use cases, organizational structure, and success criteria.
* Build strong relationships with customers across multiple levels, including users, champions, decision\-makers, procurement teams, and senior executives.
* Establish a consistent engagement cadence through discovery meetings, business reviews, strategic check\-ins, and proactive outreach.
* Create and maintain strategic account plans outlining customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, commercial potential, risks, and next actions.


Growth and Expansion

* Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within the existing customer portfolio.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, account activity, and business priorities to uncover expansion opportunities.
* Recommend appropriate products, features, commercial structures, and use cases based on the customer’s needs.
* Build and manage a healthy expansion pipeline while maintaining accurate forecasts and clear next steps.
* Lead consultative commercial conversations, including discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, and deal progression.
* Partner with relevant sales teams when an opportunity requires additional commercial or technical expertise.
* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion revenue, pipeline generation, adoption, and account engagement targets.


Adoption, Retention, and Risk Management

* Help customers maximize the value they receive from the company’s products and services.
* Proactively identify accounts with low adoption, limited engagement, unresolved issues, or potential churn risk.
* Develop clear action plans to improve adoption, rebuild engagement, and protect the long\-term customer relationship.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products and use cases that support the customer’s evolving business objectives.
* Support renewal readiness by maintaining strong account health and ensuring commercial risks are identified early.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback, product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring challenges to internal stakeholders.


Customer Issue Coordination

* Take ownership of the customer experience when commercial, billing, product, contractual, or operational issues arise.
* Assess customer concerns, determine their business impact, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process, including timelines, progress updates, and next steps.
* Escalate high\-impact or time\-sensitive issues through the correct internal channels.
* Ensure customer concerns are followed through to resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements that can reduce customer friction.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Renewals, Customer Success, Support, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver consistent and seamless customer experience.
* Ensure clear handoffs, ownership, and accountability when multiple teams are involved in an account.
* Share customer insights and commercial opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to team best practices, enablement sessions, account reviews, and continuous process improvement.


CRM and Operational Excellence

* Maintain accurate and timely records of customer interactions, account plans, opportunities, risks, and next steps in Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Keep expansion opportunities, pipeline stages, close dates, and forecasts current and reliable.
* Prepare account updates and communicate progress, blockers, and support needs to leadership.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of product capabilities, pricing, commercial policies, customer use cases, and the competitive landscape.
* Follow established sales, contracting, forecasting, escalation, and customer communication processes.

  

Basic Qualifications

  

* Minimum of 4 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success, inside sales, or renewals.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience working with SaaS, AI, or cloud\-based solutions.

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Excellent executive level written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing mid\-market or enterprise custom

jobs.title: Account Manager, Hospitality
jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join the Supply team to support client success after they go live. That means retention, growth, and the kind of relationship that makes operators choose Ande for every new location and every new initiative. You'll sit at the intersection of revenue and relationship, monitoring health signals, running strategic reviews, and building the trust that converts a live account into a long\-term, expanding partner. You are the operator's advocate, their data interpreter, and the first person to know when something is off, or when there's an opportunity worth chasing.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the post\-live revenue relationship: manage adoption, retention, and growth across an assigned book of accounts, with accountability for product usage, Net Revenue Retention, churn, and expansion
* Execute a segmented coverage model, calibrating your time and depth of engagement to revenue impact across your book
* Run proactive lifecycle management: show up before operators know they need you, at the right moments in the account lifecycle, with the right context, before friction has a chance to settle in
* Monitor and interpret product signals: track leading indicators across usage, adoption, and revenue to identify at\-risk patterns before they become churn events
* Translate what you see in the data into a clear narrative, for the operator and for your internal team
* Drive expansion in partnership with Sales: surface upsell and expansion signals early, before the operator asks and before the AE has to chase, and bring the context that makes the handoff worth acting on
* Build champions who understand the value Ande is delivering and are willing to say so

**What We're Looking For**

* 3\-6 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client\-facing revenue role
* Someone who wants to work in an AI\-first environment, who actively looks for ways to use it to do better work, move faster, and show up sharper for their accounts
* Experience managing a tiered book of business with multiple account types, coverage models, and competing priorities at once
* Comfort with data; you know how to pull signals from a dashboard, translate them into a coherent narrative, and take action proactively
* A genuine bias toward proactive outreach over reactive firefighting; you're already thinking about the next touchpoint before the last one ends
* Cross\-functional fluency; you know how to work with Sales, Product, and leadership without dropping the ball or losing the relationship thread
* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, MixMax, Claude, G\-Suite, etc., and a general comfort picking up new tools quickly

**Bonus Points**

* You've worked in hospitality, restaurant tech, or payments; you understand the operational rhythms of a venue and what actually moves operator behavior
* You have a track record of executing in ambiguous environments
* You've worked in a high\-growth or early\-stage company and know what it feels like when the process is still being written and your job is to help write it
* You've gone beyond managing to KPIs; you've helped define what good looks like, built the scorecards, and held yourself accountable to them
* You've used AI tooling in your actual workflow, not as a novelty but as a genuine lever for doing your job better

**Why This Role Matters**  

Every venue that goes live with Ande is a relationship that needs to be earned. You'll own that relationship: the retention, the growth, and the trust that makes operators choose us for the next location and the next product. You'll have real ownership over a book of business, direct access to leadership, and the opportunity to help build the CS motion as we scale.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

*Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status.*


Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K

* Experience leading and closing complex partnership agreements, including experience with negotiation, structuring, and implementation.
* Experience working cross\-functionally and managing projects with multiple stakeholders in a changing environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and financial modeling skills, with the ability to assess partnership opportunities and develop business cases.

**About the job**
