jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevard

jobs.title: In-Home Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**In\-Home Sales Representative**
=================================

### **Earn $150,000 to $200,000\+ Per Year**

### **Pre\-Qualified Leads \| No Cold Calling \| Unlimited Earning Potential**

**Build a Six\-Figure Career With One of the Fastest\-Growing Bathroom Remodeling Companies**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Are you a proven sales professional looking for a company that provides the opportunities, support, and leads needed to maximize your income?


Quality Craftsmen is expanding and actively hiring high\-performing sales professionals to meet the growing demand for our premium bathroom remodeling products. We provide a steady flow of pre\-qualified appointments with homeowners who have already expressed interest in our services, allowing you to spend your time doing what you do best: building relationships, presenting solutions, and closing sales.


This is an excellent opportunity for motivated individuals who want to earn six figures while representing a trusted company with a proven sales process, industry\-leading products, and strong marketing support.


If you're driven, competitive, and ready to take control of your earnings, we want to hear from you.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* First\-year earning potential of $150,000\+
* Top performers earn $250,000 to $300,000\+ annually
* Uncapped commission structure
* Weekly commission payouts
* Pre\-qualified, company\-generated appointments
* No cold calling, prospecting, canvassing, or door knocking
* High close\-rate sales system
* Industry\-leading products with strong consumer demand
* Comprehensive onboarding and paid training
* Ongoing coaching and professional development
* Flexible schedule
* Career advancement opportunities
* Supportive leadership and dedicated marketing team
* Established brand with an outstanding reputation

**Why Top Sales Professionals Choose Quality Craftsmen**
--------------------------------------------------------


Unlike many sales organizations, we invest heavily in marketing to ensure our sales consultants meet with homeowners who have already requested information about their remodeling projects.


Our sales team is not responsible for generating leads. There are no cold calls, no prospecting requirements, and no door\-to\-door sales. We fill your calendar with qualified appointments so you can focus on presenting solutions, closing sales, and increasing your income.


With our proven sales process, premium products, and ongoing support, you'll have the tools needed to build a rewarding and financially successful career.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Meet with homeowners during pre\-scheduled in\-home appointments
* Conduct professional design consultations using our interactive presentation system
* Evaluate customer needs and recommend customized bathroom remodeling solutions
* Educate homeowners on product options, features, financing, and pricing
* Create project proposals and present solutions that meet customers' goals
* Guide customers confidently through the decision\-making process
* Close sales and exceed performance goals
* Maintain accurate records and follow\-up activities
* Deliver a world\-class customer experience throughout the sales process
* Participate in ongoing training and development programs

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


Successful candidates are:

* Highly motivated and results\-driven
* Competitive with a strong desire to succeed
* Professional, polished, and confident
* Excellent communicators and relationship builders
* Comfortable presenting in customers' homes
* Self\-disciplined and able to work independently
* Coachable and committed to continuous improvement
* Organized and effective at managing their schedule
* Passionate about helping customers improve their homes

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------


Experience in any of the following industries is highly valued:

* Home Improvement Sales
* Bathroom Remodeling
* Kitchen Remodeling
* Roofing
* HVAC
* Windows and Doors
* Solar Energy
* Flooring
* Construction Sales
* Real Estate
* Automotive Sales
* Insurance Sales
* High\-Ticket Retail Sales
* In\-Home Sales


Previous in\-home sales experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with a proven track record of success in commission\-based sales environments are encouraged to apply.

**About Quality Craftsmen**
---------------------------


Quality Craftsmen is a recognized leader in bathroom remodeling, delivering exceptional products, professional installations, and outstanding customer service. As our company continues to grow, we remain committed to investing in our people through training, technology, marketing, and career development opportunities.


We believe top performers deserve to be rewarded for their results. That's why we provide the resources, support, and earning potential necessary to build a long\-term, six\-figure career.

**Apply Today**
---------------


If you're looking for a sales opportunity where your earnings are driven by your performance, not limited by a salary cap, this is the role for you.


Join Quality Craftsmen and build a career with unlimited income potential, pre\-qualified leads, and a company committed to your success.

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:
**About Winship Cancer Institute of Emory University**  

Dedicated to discovering cures for cancer and inspiring hope, Winship Cancer Institute of Emory University is Georgia’s only National Cancer Institute\-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, a prestigious distinction given to the top tier of cancer centers nationwide for making breakthroughs against cancer. Winship is researching, developing, teaching, and providing novel and highly effective ways to prevent, detect, diagnose, treat, and survive cancer. Cancer care at Winship includes leading cancer specialists collaborating across disciplines to tailor treatment plans to each patient’s needs and type of cancer; innovative therapies and clinical trials; comprehensive patient and family support services; and a personalized care experience aimed at easing the burden of cancer. Winship is Where Science Becomes Hope®. For more information, visit winshipcancer.emory.edu. **Winship is seeking qualified candidates for the Clinical Research Coordinator III position.** **Position details are as follows:**  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Independently manages significant and key aspects of a large clinical trial or all aspects of one or more small trials, or research projects.
* Trains and provides guidance to less experienced staff.
* Oversees data management for research projects.
* Interfaces with research participants and resolves issues related to study protocols.
* Authorizes purchases for supplies and equipment maintenance.
* Determines effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long term clinical trials.
* Periodically audits operations including laboratory procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provides leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes.
* Monitors IRB submissions and responds to requests and questions.
* Interfaces with study sponsors, monitors and reports SAEs; resolves study queries.
* Provides leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes.
* Assists in developing grant proposals and protocols.
* With appropriate credentialing and training may perform phlebotomy, specimens collection or diagnostics.
* May perform some supervisory duties.
* Performs related approved responsibilities as required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
* High School Diploma or GED and seven years of clinical research experience.
* Or two years of college in a scientific, health related or business administration program and five years of clinical research experience
* Or licensed as a Practical Nurse (LPN) and four years of clinical research experience
* Or bachelor's degree in a scientific, health related or business administration program and three years clinical research experience
* Or master's degree, MD or PhD in a scientific, health related or business administration program and one year of clinical research experience Certified Research Administrator (CRA) or Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) preferred.


This position is intended to support clinical research and all clinical training requirements must be tracked and monitored through Emory Healthcare under the credentialing category of Clinical Researcher.

Responsibilities include managing schedules, coordinating meetings and events, handling confidential information, and other duties as assigned.

* Manage the Dean’s calendar, schedule meetings, and coordinate travel arrangements.
* Prepare and edit correspondence and reports.

  

Office Operations:

Event and Meeting Coordination:

* Coordinate logistics, prepare agendas, and record minutes.

  

Records, Reporting, and Data Management:

* Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with University policies.
* Compile and analyze data for reports, including annual reports and accreditation documentation.
* Maintain databases and ensure data integrity.

  

Communication and Liaison:

* Interface with faculty, staff, students, and external partners professionally and effectively.

A bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university and one year of prior administrative support experience is required. In lieu of education, equivalent directly relevant experience, preferably as an administrative or executive assistant, will be considered.

* Knowledge of scheduling, record\-keeping, and administrative workflows.
* Familiarity with expense tracking, procurement, and basic financial reporting.
* Awareness of FERPA regulations and institutional confidentiality standards.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, calendar management systems, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and complex schedules efficiently.
* Strong written and verbal communication for drafting correspondence and reports.
* Skilled at anticipating needs, resolving scheduling conflicts, and handling unexpected issues.
* Ability to plan and execute meetings, conferences, and special events.
* Competence in data entry, document formatting, and using collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, Zoom).
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Capacity to work in a fast\-paced environment and adjust to changing priorities.
* Ability to build positive relationships with faculty, staff, and external stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of software systems (e.g., Workday, etc.).
* Excellent attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in documents, schedules, communication, etc.
* Ability to work collaboratively.
* Ability to compile, analyze, and present data accurately.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and make sound administrative decisions.

 **Background Check Contingencies:**

* Criminal History

* Resume
* Cover letter
* List of three professional references with contact information

jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.


We are looking for an experienced attorney to join Snowflake's Legal team as Director, Assistant General Counsel \- Litigation. In this role, you will manage a diverse portfolio of litigation matters, serve as a trusted partner and advisor to the business, leverage artificial intelligence to enhance the way we get work done, and supervise one in\-house litigation counsel. This role will report to Snowflake’s Senior Director, Associate General Counsel \- Employment \& Litigation. This is an in\-person role based in Menlo Park, CA or Atlanta, GA. This is not a remote position.

**Responsibilities**

***Litigation Management and Advising***

* Working collaboratively with our Legal team, outside counsel, and cross\-functional stakeholders, manage disputes and litigation matters across their full lifecycle — from initial case assessment through resolution.
* Lead and manage internal investigations on matters involving legal risks to Snowflake, including coordinating with the People team, Security organization, and other relevant functions.
* Manage and coordinate responses to subpoenas, garnishment orders, domestic relations orders, statutory requests for information, and requests from government and law enforcement agencies.
* Review and advise on litigation\-related contractual provisions in commercial agreements, including dispute resolution, governing law, venue, arbitration, limitation of liability, and indemnification clauses.
* Advise business stakeholders on litigation risks and issues involved in business disputes; pragmatically weigh legal risks and benefits of complex situations and propose practical, business\-oriented solutions with tact and maturity.
* Manage outside counsel relationships, including matter staffing, billing review, and strategic direction of litigation.
* Partner with privacy counsel and other specialists on disputes involving data, security, or regulatory matters.

***Process \& Infrastructure***

* Lead efforts to create, improve, and scale processes and procedures related to the handling of litigation matters for a rapidly growing, global company, including litigation hold protocols, matter tracking, reporting, and knowledge management.
* Partner with legal operations on litigation\-related technology, data, and workflow improvements.
* Develop and maintain internal resources, templates, and playbooks to support consistent and efficient litigation management.

**Requirements**

* JD from an accredited law school, active membership in at least one state bar, and ability to practice in the jurisdiction in which this position is located.
* Minimum of 8 years of legal experience, with substantive in\-house litigation management and law firm experience; people management experience a plus.
* Proven experience managing complex litigation matters; class action experience a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage outside counsel, control litigation budgets, and set case strategy.
* Experience conducting and coordinating internal investigations.
* Experience managing responses to subpoenas and government/law enforcement inquiries.
* Ability to explain complicated legal concepts in plain language.
* Strong organizational skills, exceptional judgment, and comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Fosters team collaboration through high\-quality work, a positive attitude, and clear, solution\-focused communication.

 *Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.*


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com


The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* The estimated base salary range for this role is $234,000 \- $307,600\.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.


The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

Live4Lali has been serving suburban Chicagoland for nearly sixteen years providing critical prevention, education, treatment access, support programs, community solutions\-building initiatives, risk reduction, and overdose prevention services to decrease the devastating toll of the opioid epidemic. mission is to reduce stigma and prevent substance use disorder among individuals, families, and communities, and minimize the overall health, legal and social harms associated with substance use.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

The Kane/DuPage Counties Outreach Coordinator reports to the Kane/DuPage Counties Program Manager and works collaboratively with other Outreach Coordinators. This role focuses on community\-based outreach to provide education on risk reduction strategies, naloxone, and overdose prevention, while building trusting relationships with people who use substances. The Outreach Coordinator must be bilingual in Spanish and also provides peer\-based support, drawing on lived experience to reduce harms associated with substance use and connect individuals to resources and support.

Under the direct supervision of the Kane/DuPage Counties Program Manager, the Full\-Time (40 hours) Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator will be part of the Live4Lali team, engaged in the following activities:

* Core Responsibilities

Identify areas of greatest need across Kane/Dupage Counties on the street and within existing services (such as our Mobile Outreach Program) to connect with participants and distribute risk reduction supplies

Provide peer\-based support to participants through rapport building, recovery coaching, risk reduction–informed interventions, and referrals, using lived experience to support participant\-defined goals and reduce harms associated with substance use.

Assist with stocking, maintaining, and delivering risk reduction inventory

Accurately log and report data collected during outreach.

Provide on the spot training and education in risk reduction, overdose response, and distribute naloxone, the opioid overdose reversal medication across the county

**WHO WE ARE**



Interdependence is a tech\-powered, integrated marketing and communications agency built around one core belief: strategy comes first.



Founded in public relations, we've grown into a full\-service partner spanning PR, social media, paid media, brand strategy and consulting, event marketing, influencer marketing, website strategy and development, and integrated marketing planning. We continue to expand our capabilities based on what our clients need and where we can make the greatest impact.



Our approach starts with our clients' goals, not a predetermined set of services. We look at the bigger picture, identify the channels and strategies best positioned to drive results, and build the right plan around them. When the best solution falls outside our own capabilities, we're willing to say so. Achieving our clients' goals is always the priority.



We combine smart strategy, experienced people and technology, including our Newsweek AI Impact Award\-winning Interviewed™ platform, to deliver measurable results. Just as importantly, we believe how we work matters. Kindness, collaboration, curiosity and accountability shape how we partner with our clients and each other. As a remote team, we're building an agency where great people can do great work, grow their careers and feel valued along the way.

  


**THE MISSION**


**Help turn client goals into organized, thoughtful marketing programs while becoming a trusted, proactive contributor to the Integrated Marketing \& Strategy team.**



Our team supports clients across influencer marketing, events, brand strategy and identity, website strategy and development and other integrated marketing needs. Account Executives help connect the client, the strategy and the people responsible for bringing the work to life.



Your job is to keep projects moving, communicate clearly, anticipate what is needed next and help solve problems before they become roadblocks. As you grow in the role, the expectation is that you look beyond assigned tasks, develop stronger client and business judgment, and take greater ownership of day\-to\-day work.

  


**THREE** **PRINCIPLES**


* **Client goals come first.** Start with what the client needs to accomplish, then help determine the channels, partners and next steps best positioned to support that goal.
* **Stay one step ahead.** Do not wait to be asked for the obvious next step. Keep the team informed, flag risks early and think about what the client or project will need next.
* **Be curious and resourceful.** You will not always have an immediate answer. Ask smart questions, research options, talk to new people and bring forward a recommended path rather than stopping at the problem.

  


**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


* **You are not expected to arrive as an expert in every marketing channel.** Specific influencer, event, brand or website experience is helpful but not required. You are expected to learn quickly, understand how different disciplines work together and build broader channel knowledge over time.
* **You are not expected to lead client strategy alone.** Senior team members own overarching strategy, senior counsel and complex client conversations. You are expected to understand that strategy, contribute ideas and increasingly connect your work to the client's broader goals.

  


**KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Client \& Account Support**


* Support day\-to\-day client relationships while developing a strong understanding of each client's business, goals, audiences and ways of working.
* Prepare meeting agendas and materials, participate in client calls, capture decisions and next steps and complete follow\-ups without repeated prompting.
* Translate client questions and feedback into clear direction for internal teams, asking questions when details or priorities are unclear.
* Keep account leads informed of progress, next steps, opportunities and potential challenges.


**Integrated Project Management**


* Help manage projects from kickoff through delivery, keeping scopes, timelines, budgets, approvals, deliverables and outstanding decisions organized.
* Coordinate work across account, strategy, creative, web, paid media, PR and outside partners so everyone understands what is needed and when.
* Support assignments across influencer campaigns, events, brand strategy and identity, website redesigns, consulting engagements and website builds as client needs shift.
* Identify potential roadblocks early, raise them with the appropriate team members and help develop practical solutions that keep the work moving.
* Review materials for accuracy, completeness and alignment with the brief before they are shared internally or with clients.


**Influencer Programs \& Events**


* Research creators, partners, vendors, venues and other resources that align with client goals, audiences and budgets.
* Support outreach, vetting, contracting, logistics, content reviews, approvals, product shipments, guest lists, invitations and other program details.
* Communicate professionally with creators, vendors and new contacts and confidently ask the questions needed to evaluate options or solve problems.
* Provide on\-site event and activation support as needed and remain calm, flexible and solutions\-focused when plans change.


**Creative \& Strategic Contribution**


* Actively contribute ideas during brainstorms, planning sessions and account discussions.
* Conduct research that helps the team understand audiences, competitors, cultural trends, potential partners and new approaches.
* Show genuine interest in creative work and help move ideas from early concepts through final execution.

**Location:** Remote position but candidates will live in Chicago and are local to the nearest airport as this role requires up to 70% travel


**Salary range:** $170,000 \- $200,000 depending on experience


**Position Summary:** This is a full\-time position working within our Sales team.

  


**The Opportunity**



We're looking for an experienced and passionate Oncology Account Manager to join our sales team to help drive our mission forward within the oncology space. This is a unique opportunity to be part of something truly meaningful at a pivotal moment in our expansion.



These are foundational roles within our newest therapeutic area, giving you the chance to make a real impact and support patients living with rare hematologic and oncologic conditions.



You'll join a driven and fast\-growing organization with a strong track record within the oncology pharma space. You'll have the opportunity to lead engagement with HCPs and clinics across your territory, educate on disease and treatment pathways, and support access via our specialty pharmacy and/or Cycle Vita patient hub. You'll also collaborate cross\-functionally to help drive launch success and build strong relationships across the haematology/oncology landscape.

At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that **Every Single Patient Matters**. This is at the heart of why we work and were looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life\-changing treatments need life\-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.



At Cycle Pharma, we focus on providing treatments and services for patients with neurological, rare metabolic, and rare immunological conditions, most of which are genetic conditions. Some of our patients are diagnosed with a rare disease at birth, others are affected later in life, and some can spend years trying to get diagnosed. No matter what stage our patients or their caregivers are at, we strive to provide them with the support they require. If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:



Patient Stories \- Cycle Pharma

  


**What you will be doing**


* Drive adoption of Cycle Pharmaceuticals leading haematology and oncology therapies across haematology and oncology by engaging with physicians, nurses, and healthcare staff through face\-to\-face and virtual channels.
* Build awareness of oncology rare disease conditions, therapeutic solutions, and the individualized support services available through Cycle Vita.
* Educate providers on prescribing pathways within community oncology, Cycle Vita patient hub, and specialty pharmacies to streamline patient access to treatments.
* Identify, engage, and partner with key opinion leaders to support peer\-to\-peer education and community outreach.
* Lead territory\-level execution of new product launches and marketing strategies to maximize reach and impact.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Market Access, Marketing, and Field Leadership to align on strategy and field insights.
* Ensure accurate CRM documentation, maintain compliance, and develop and deliver quarterly business plans tailored to your market dynamics.

  


**What you'll bring**

* Experience in haematology and oncology required.
* Proven successful field\-based sales experience in biopharmaceuticals.
* Proven ability to meet/exceed performance goals.
* Collaborative, ethical, and proactive team player.
* Strong communication and CRM/data skills.
* Willingness to travel up to 70%.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

  


**What makes this role special**


* Be part of building something new from the ground up.
* Make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients with serious, underserved conditions.
* Work across diverse therapeutic areas and projects.
* Join a team that values agility, initiative, and collaboration.
* Learn from leaders with deep experience and strong patient focus.

  


**What can we offer to you**

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonus
* Employer funded private health insurance
* Life insurance and 401(k) plan
* Agile working policy and home\-based flexibility
* A fast\-paced, supportive, and ambitious work environment

Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. * Generate and qualify sales opportunities through customer outreach, networking, and lead follow\-up activities.
* Maintain opportunity pipelines, forecasts, and customer information within CRM systems.
* Support contract, quotation, and proposal activities in partnership with internal teams.
* Work cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Customer Support, and Operations teams to ensure customer success.
* Stay informed on industry trends, customer applications, and emerging technologies.
* Deliver a high level of customer satisfaction while contributing to long\-term business growth.

  


Qualifications: **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering Technology, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* US Person.
* 5\+ years of professional experience, including internships, co\-op programs, technical support, engineering, business development, or customer\-facing roles.
* Strong interest in technology, sales, customer relationship management, and business development.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to learn complex technical concepts and communicate them effectively.
* Self\-motivated with a positive attitude and desire to grow within a sales organization.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

* Internship, co\-op, or academic project experience in RF, wireless communications, electronics, semiconductors, aerospace and defense, automotive, or test and measurement technologies.

* Exposure to customer\-facing activities, presentations, technical demonstrations, or sales projects.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

**About the Job**


The Associate Project Manager \- UAX Fleet is a pivotal cross\-functional role within the United Express organization responsible for managing the end\-to\-end execution of aircraft modification and fleet enhancement initiatives. This position partners with engineering teams, maintenance providers, airline partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver complex projects that improve the customer experience while minimizing aircraft downtime and operational disruption. The successful candidate combines strong project management discipline, technical aptitude, financial oversight, and stakeholder management skills to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with regulatory requirements.

**Core Accountabilities**

* Lead the planning and execution of aircraft modification and fleet enhancement projects from project initiation through implementation.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and change control processes to effectively manage scope, budget, schedules, and dependencies.
* Coordinate activities across partner airlines, maintenance facilities, engineering teams, vendors, procurement, and internal stakeholders to ensure project success.
* Monitor project budgets, vendor invoices, and cost performance while providing recommendations to address variances and maintain financial objectives.
* Prepare executive status reports, steering committee materials, and project updates that clearly communicate progress, risks, mitigation plans, and resource requirements.
* Support contract\-related activities including Statements of Work (SOWs), service agreements, procurement coordination, and vendor management.
* Translate technical requirements, engineering data, service bulletins, and modification documentation into executable project timelines while supporting FAA compliance activities.
* Provide flexible support across fleet programs, prototype installations, and other strategic operational initiatives as business needs evolve.


NOTE: This position provides a hybrid work arrangement including approximately 50% of the time spent working onsite at our Chicago office location and remotely.

**Qualifications**

### **What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aviation, Management or equivalent technical/quantitative discipline
* 2\+ years of experience in aviation, technical project management, engineering, operations management, or a related field
* Demonstrated success delivering projects using established project management methodologies and practices
* Experience creating presentations and communicating analytical findings to senior leadership
* Ability to interpret technical engineering data and drawings, to translate them into business\-focused project plans and timelines
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel
* Ability to work independently, identify process gaps, and develop data\-driven solutions
* Strong communication, collaboration, organizational, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%, including visits to maintenance facilities, vendors, and partner airline locations
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
* Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
* Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

* Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation and problem solving. Apply critical thinking to validate AI\-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy and security.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Aviation, Management, or a related technical or quantitative discipline
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or comparable project management or process improvement certification
* Experience within the airline or aviation industry
* Experience supporting commercial aviation fleet modifications, MRO organizations, or airline Technical Operations teams
* Knowledge of United Express operations and regional airline networks

We're looking for motivated individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit who excel at developing new relationships, deeply understand SMB's biggest challenges, and have the drive to make a significant impact in their local communities.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
GardaWorld is shaping the future of cash management! We provide our clients with solutions in every phase of their cash supply chain, including secured transportation, cash management, cash vault processing, forecasting, ATM, and cash recycler services. We are equipped with the largest fleet of armored vehicles in the industry, sophisticated technology, and an expansive network of experienced employees and innovative partners. We process, manage, and move over $8B in cash every day while delivering 24/7 client support and logistical expertise.
  
  

Field Sales Representative
  
Own a territory. Build a market. Win new business.
  
GardaWorld Cash Services is seeking a driven Field Sales Representative to expand our presence with local and regional commercial customers. This field\-based new\-business development role is designed for a true sales hunter—someone energized by opening doors, building relationships, creating opportunities, and closing profitable business.
  
You will develop your assigned territory through face\-to\-face prospecting, consultative selling, networking, referrals, and targeted outreach. By understanding how prospective customers manage cash today, you will recommend GardaWorld solutions that improve security, visibility, efficiency, and control.
  
This is not an account\-management or primarily desk\-based sales position. Success requires a consistent market presence, disciplined pipeline development, and the resilience to turn initial conversations into long\-term customer partnerships.
  
**Compensation:** $65,000 \- $75,000 base salary plus commission.
  
**Location:** Chicago, IL
  
**Travel:** Significant local and regional travel based on territory size, customer needs, and business requirements. Regular face\-to\-face prospecting and customer meetings are essential. Limited overnight travel may be required.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Develop and execute a new\-business sales strategy for an assigned geographic territory.
* Identify high\-potential prospects, industries, and commercial areas within the market.
* Build a qualified sales pipeline through in\-person prospecting, telephone outreach, referrals, networking, and other lead\-generation activities.
* Establish relationships with decision\-makers at local, regional, and multi\-location businesses.
* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospective customers’ cash\-handling practices, operational challenges, and business priorities.
* Present GardaWorld Cash Services capabilities, including secure cash transportation, deposit solutions, cash automation, cash recycling, cash\-management services, cash information and reporting solutions, ClearValue, and other evolving solutions.
* Recommend solutions that align with each customer’s operational and commercial requirements.
* Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
* Partner with Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, Implementation, and Sales leadership to develop solutions that can be successfully delivered.
* Participate in pricing and contract discussions and negotiate within established approval requirements.
* Advance qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle and close profitable new business.
* Maintain ownership of new opportunities through contract execution and support a successful transition to implementation.
* Maintain accurate and timely prospecting, pipeline, and sales activity information in applicable systems.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Provide leadership with actionable feedback regarding territory potential and market trends.
* Meet or exceed individual objectives for prospecting, customer meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline growth, proposals, new\-customer acquisition, revenue, profitability, and territory penetration.
* Operate as a collaborative member of a high\-performance sales organization built on accountability, communication, positive energy, and execution.


Skills/Qualifications
  
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated success in B2B sales, outside sales, territory sales, or new\-business development.
* Proven ability to generate leads independently, build a qualified pipeline, and close new customers.
* Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Confidence initiating conversations with prospective customers through face\-to\-face and telephone outreach.
* Ability to understand customer business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
* Strong territory\-planning, organizational, and pipeline\-management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated, resilient, competitive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance, Legal, and Implementation.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard business technology.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory.


Experience in cash management, payments, merchant services, financial services, commercial banking, treasury services, ATM technology, cash automation, secure logistics, route\-based commercial services, retail technology, business services, security services, or another complex B2B service environment is preferred.
  
Direct cash\-in\-transit or armored transportation experience is not required. We are looking for candidates with a demonstrated ability to enter a market, develop relationships, create pipeline, and win new business.
  
  

EOE, Drug\-Free Workplace
  
  

GardaWorld is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.
  
  

Cash Services Headquarters
  
2000 NW Corporate Boulevard

Description:  



**Position Summary**


We are seeking an organized, detail\-oriented Inside Sales / Project Coordinator to support our sales team and coordinate projects from initial inquiry through quoting, submittals, approvals, and production release. This role partners closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Shipping, as well as external sales reps, dealers, customers, and contractors to ensure projects are quoted accurately, documented correctly, and executed on schedule.


The ideal candidate has experience reading blueprints or construction drawings, preparing quotes and proposals, coordinating multiple projects, and providing excellent customer service. Experience in restaurant equipment, commercial kitchens, manufacturing, construction, millwork, stainless\-steel fabrication, or a related industry is preferred.


Requirements:  



**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Prepare quotes and proposals in AutoQuotes; support special\-order pricing and product substitutions as needed. Ensure quotes and submittal packages are delivered accurately and on time.
* Review architectural/equipment plans, specifications, and shop drawings to identify requirements, constraints, and scope gaps.
* Coordinate submittal and drawing packages with internal teams and external parties; manage drawing revisions and approval cycles.
* Confirm product dimensions, finishes, quantities, and specifications prior to production release.
* Maintain accurate project files, correspondence, and status updates in company systems.
* Coordinate projects from the sales and estimating stages through production, delivery, and installation coordination.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for sales representatives, dealers, and consultants regarding project status and documentation.
* Communicate schedule risks, missing information, and conflicts early to keep projects on track.
* Track project schedules, manufacturing timelines, approvals, deliveries, and installation dates.
* Track quote status and follow up on, pending approvals, customer questions, and outstanding project information.
* Identify potential project conflicts, missing information, or scheduling concerns and communicate them promptly.
* Provide customers and outside sales representatives with timely project updates.
* Help resolve issues such as order discrepancies, manufacturing errors, and other customer concerns in partnership with internal teams.
* Participate in sales meetings and provide updates on active projects.
* Develop strong working relationships with customers and support repeat business opportunities.
* Perform additional sales\-support and project\-coordination duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business, construction management, engineering, design, or a related field is preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in inside sales, project coordination, estimating, manufacturing, construction, restaurant equipment, or a related industry preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, equipment plans, architectural plans, specifications, equipment schedules, and/or shop drawings.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Customer\-service\-focused approach with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with outside sales and internal departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Experience using CRM, ERP, quoting, order\-entry, or project\-management software is preferred.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, measurements, dimensions, materials, and lead times is preferred.
* Experience with commercial restaurant equipment, stainless\-steel fabrication, millwork, cabinetry, refrigeration, or food\-service construction is a plus.

**Skills and Competencies**

Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. **Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.

**R**ole Description  

As an Account Manager with Marcus Brown State Farm, you will play an important role in the agency’s daily operations, customer retention, and continued growth. You will build meaningful customer relationships, identify insurance needs, and recommend appropriate products and services.

* Recommend, explain, and sell appropriate insurance products to new and existing customers.

* Assist customers with policy questions, billing concerns, coverage updates, and other service needs.
* Coordinate with agency team members to resolve complex customer concerns.
* Maintain accurate customer records and document follow\-up activities.
* Meet individual and agency sales goals.
* Provide professional service in both English and Spanish.

* Previous insurance sales or account management experience is preferred.

* Ability to manage multiple customer needs and follow\-up responsibilities.
* Commitment to ethical sales practices and exceptional customer service.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

**Why Wells Fargo:**


Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work\-life balance and well\-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

 **About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Branch Operations Associate Manager (LO) for our National Branch Network as part of the Consumer Banking and Lending division. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Lead and supervise risk and the operations of teller functions to deliver exceptional customer service and colleague experience, and ensure timely completion, quality, and compliance in teller functions
* Provide feedback and present ideas for improving customer service and colleague experience, and related performance management process and tools
* Perform operational and customer support tasks
* Provide excellent customer service, engage customers in conversations, and build relationships with them
* Manage the schedule and the daily operations of the teller line
* Make decisions and resolve issues related to daily operations of the teller line, under direction of regional banking management
* Leverage interpretation of applicable regulations, policy and procedure requirements, and audit and escalation procedures
* Support customers and employees in resolving or escalating concerns or complaints
* Collaborate and consult with branch employees, colleagues, and mid\-level managers
* Interact directly with customers
* Coach, motivate, and develop a diverse team of direct reports to achieve full potential and meet established business objectives
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for branch operations
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent
* This LO position has customer contact and job duties which may include needs assessing and referring those customers interested in a dwelling secured product to a SAFE team member. This position includes assisting customers without taking an application and without offering or negotiating terms of a dwelling secured transaction. Individuals in a LO position also must meet the Loan Originator requirements under Regulation Z (LO) outlined in the job expectations below

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience assessing and meeting the needs of customers or helping with issue resolution, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 1\+ years of Leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Leadership skills including the ability to build, develop, and motivate a diverse work team
* Ability to provide strong customer service while listening, eliciting information efficiently, comprehending, and resolving complex customer issues
* Customer service, operations, or financial services management experience within a high volume, fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Ability to educate and connect customers to technology and share the value of mobile banking options
* Ability to interact with integrity and professionalism with customers and employees
* Knowledge and understanding of laws and regulations pertaining to the banking industry
* Knowledge and understanding of retail compliance controls, risk management, and loss prevention
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, meet deadlines, exercise independent judgment, and use critical thinking skills
* Relevant military experience including working with military protocol and instructions, enlisted evaluations, officer/leadership reporting
* Relevant military experience including working in personnel benefits management, processing military personnel orders or transitions, wartime readiness operations, human resources or military recruiting
* Cash handling experience

 **Job Expectations:**

* Ability to work a schedule that may include most Saturdays
* Individuals in Loan Originator (LO) positions must meet the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau qualification requirements and comply with related Wells Fargo policies. The LO qualification requirements include meeting applicable financial responsibility, character, general financial fitness, and criminal background standards. A current credit report will be used to assess your financial responsibility and credit fitness. However, a credit score is not included as part of the evaluation. Successful candidates must also meet ongoing regulatory requirements including additional screening, if necessary
* This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

**About Saber Foundation Repair**

**Three Decades of Service**


Saber was born in 1987 as an innovative concrete and foundation business with a goal of providing fast service and unsurpassed quality for our customers.

  

For more than 30 years, that philosophy continues to remain at the core of our business. Our track record of delivering service and quality has enabled us to obtain coveted certifications to install the finest manufactured products in the industry; however, the accolades from Saber customers are what we value most.

  

Saber carries a long tradition of leadership and innovation in the foundation repair industry. Since we opened our doors, the company has continued to expand its already comprehensive product and service line to meet each and every client’s problem within the home.


From foundation leveling and underpinning to concrete raising, our company is sure to have the solution and experience for your foundation.

  

Saber is privately\-owned and family operated and we take your trust seriously and truly value your business. Saber now offers services throughout Southern California from Los Angeles and Santa Ana to San Diego and Long Beach.

  

We're on a mission to redefine the industry. That's why we are proud to be a part of Thrasher Partners.

 **Step Into a High\-Impact Sales Career and Join Our Mission to Redefine Our Industry**


If you're wired to win, perform best when the bar is high, and want a role where outcomes define success, we want you. At Saber Foundation Repair, we're setting a new standard in an industry that has settled for mediocre for too long. We keep our word and deliver real solutions that protect homeowners and elevate the profession.

**The Role**


As an Outside Sales Representative, you will:

* Meet with pre\-qualified homeowners, (no cold\-calling). Each of our homeowners asked for your expertise, (no wasted time).
* Use our proven diagnostic process to efficiently identify issues and get them resolved.
* Lead decisive, high\-clarity conversations that drive partnership between you and the homeowner.
* Do what's right, not what's easy. Bring excellence to every homeowner, every time.

**Why High Performers Choose Saber Foundation Repair**

* Uncapped earning potential: *our top reps consistently earn $200k–$260k\+*
* High autonomy: *focus on closing, not prospecting*
* Serious growth: *we invest in developing leaders and promoting from within*
* Mission with momentum: *we’re redefining an industry, not maintaining one*
* Full benefits: *Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with 5% match, HSA and more*

**Who You Are**

* Competitive, driven, and energized by goals and results.
* Charismatic, persuasive, and comfortable steering high\-stakes conversations.
* Sharp and able to follow a proven playbook while adapting in real time.
* At your best when the bar is high, the pace is fast, and the rewards match the effort.
* Motivated by impact, income, and the satisfaction of earning big.
* Sales experience is helpful but not required. We're more focused on mindset, coachability, and work ethic\- we'll teach the rest.


If you’re ready to join a team where decisiveness, ambition, and influence translate to real results and real compensation, the opportunity is right in front of you.


Are you ready?

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager & Lead Generation Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Social Media Manager \& Lead Generation SpecialistAbout the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled **Social Media Manager \& Lead Generation Specialist** to join our growing team. This is a hands\-on position for someone who understands that social media is not just about posting content it is a lead\-generation and revenue\-driving channel.

The ideal candidate is an expert in generating high\-volume leads through social media, paid advertising, organic content, and targeted campaigns. You should be comfortable managing multiple platforms, creating professional content from start to finish, running Meta advertising campaigns, analyzing performance, and continuously finding ways to increase lead volume and engagement.

This is an in\-office, full\-time position for someone who is creative, analytical, highly organized, and results\-driven.

Key Responsibilities

**Lead Generation \& Digital Marketing**

* Develop and execute strategies designed to generate a high volume of qualified leads.
* Create and manage lead\-generation campaigns across social media and digital platforms.
* Build, launch, monitor, and optimize **Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns**.
* Test different ads, audiences, offers, messaging, and creative to improve performance.
* Track lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rates, engagement, and campaign performance.
* Identify opportunities to increase lead flow through both paid and organic marketing.
* Work closely with the sales team to ensure leads are being generated with quality and volume in mind.

Social Media Management

* Developing and maintaining a consistent social media content calendar.
* Creating and publishing engaging content across platforms.
* Growing audience reach, engagement, and brand awareness.
* Monitoring comments, messages, trends, and audience interactions.
* Researching current social media trends and identifying opportunities to increase reach.
* Repurposing content across multiple platforms while adapting it to each platform's format and audience.
* Maintaining a professional and consistent brand image.

Content Creation \& Video Editing

You should be comfortable with:

* Canva — advanced/professional level
* Professional graphic design
* Video editing
* Short\-form video creation
* Reels and TikToks
* Motion graphics and animation
* Text animation
* Transitions and effects
* Captions/subtitles

Experience with professional editing software such as **Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, CapCut Pro, or similar platforms** is highly preferred.

Analytics \& Optimization

* Monitor social media and advertising performance.
* Analyze which campaigns and content are generating the strongest results.
* Track key metrics including leads, cost per lead, reach, engagement, video views, click\-through rates, and conversions.
* Make data\-driven adjustments to improve campaign performance.
* Provide regular reporting on lead generation and social media performance.

What We're Looking For

This position is best suited for someone who can say **YES** to most of the following:

* Proven experience generating leads through social media and digital advertising.
* Strong experience with Meta Ads Manager.
* Demonstrated ability to generate high\-volume leads.
* Advanced Canva skills.
* Strong video editing skills.
* Experience creating Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, and short\-form content.
* Experience with animation and motion graphics.
* Strong understanding of social media algorithms, trends, and content strategy.
* Experience managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.
* Strong copywriting and ability to write compelling hooks and calls\-to\-action.
* Understanding of paid advertising, targeting, retargeting, and audience development.
* Ability to analyze campaign data and make strategic adjustments.
* Highly creative but also highly analytical.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Able to work independently and take ownership of projects.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.

**Schedule Requirements**

* Full\-time, In\-office position
* Monday–Friday
* 8:30 AM–5:00 PM

**Work Location:** In person

**Bringing a Portfolio or examples of previous work to interviews are strongly encouraged.**

**Parking Information for interviews:** Please be aware that parking in the structure is not validated. Street parking is available nearby, and we encourage applicants to plan accordingly.

Pay: $1,200\.00 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* Lead generation: 1 year (Preferred)
* Social media management: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Creating a world where pets live longer, healthier lives, from their very first meal.
 ### **Learn more about our brands.**

**We're Looking For A(n):** Executive Assistant


**Location:** Onsite (Burbank/North Hollywood, CA)


**What You'll Be Doing:** The Executive Assistant will serve as the executive's right hand, increasing their effective capacity by organizing time, attention, commitments, information, and the working environment around the highest\-value priorities. This role will provide traditional executive support across calendar management, scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, coordination, and follow\-through, while also taking broad ownership of the day\-to\-day operation of a new office and studio.  

  

This is a highly proactive, ownership\-oriented role responsible for creating structure where it does not yet exist, building repeatable processes, coordinating people and projects through changing information, and continuously reducing operational friction. The role will also leverage technology, AI, and automation to make work faster, more reliable, and less dependent on manual effort or individual memory.  

  

The scope of the role will evolve over time. The expectation is that the Executive Assistant will anticipate needs, exercise independent judgment, identify and resolve issues, and build systems that allow the executive and broader operation to function more effectively with less direct intervention.


* Manage the executive's calendar, priorities, scheduling, travel, and logistics.
* Prepare for meetings and ensure decisions, commitments, and open items are tracked through completion.
* Coordinate internal and external communications, meetings, people, and projects on behalf of the executive.
* Manage day\-to\-day office and studio operations, ensuring the environment is organized, functional, and ready to support ongoing business activities.
* Support the development and buildout of the new office and studio, including vendors, timelines, logistics, technology, physical\-space needs, and other operational requirements.
* Select, coordinate, and manage vendors and external partners as needed.
* Oversee office supplies, equipment, technology, and recurring operational needs.
* Coordinate guest, meeting, and other office/studio logistics.
* Build and maintain workflows, checklists, documentation, and operating processes where needed.
* Identify recurring operational friction and address the underlying process rather than repeatedly solving the same issue.
* Maintain systems for information, documents, contacts, decisions, and follow\-up.


Use AI, automation, and other technology to simplify repetitive, information\-heavy, or rules\-based work.  

* Ensure decisions are translated into action and that actions are completed.
* Identify what requires executive attention versus what can be handled independently, escalating appropriately when needed.
* Take on additional responsibilities as the needs of the executive, office, and studio evolve.


**Qualifications (Note: We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't tick ALL of these boxes.):**


* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
* Strong ownership mentality with a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach.
* Highly anticipatory; able to think downstream and identify needs, dependencies, risks, and follow\-up before they become urgent.
* Process\-oriented with a continuous\-improvement mindset; able to identify inefficient or overly manual processes and build better ways of working.
* Strong independent judgment and ability to determine when issues can be handled independently versus escalated.
* High processing speed and ability to synthesize fragmented information from multiple sources into clear priorities, decisions, and actions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly as needs and circumstances change.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across people, teams, vendors, and external partners.
* Comfortable providing and receiving direct feedback, challenging priorities when appropriate, and surfacing contradictions or issues.
* Strong discretion and judgment when handling sensitive business and personal information.
* Service\-oriented, practical, and persistent, without being passive or overly dependent on direction.
* Comfortable experimenting with modern technology, AI tools, automation, and custom workflows to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Ambitious and curious, with an interest in learning how the broader business operates and taking on increasing responsibility over time.



Required Experience:2\+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or a related role


**Golden Perks \& Benefits:**
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage – We cover **100% of premiums** for medical, dental, and vision plans for employee\-only plans.
* Annual bonus
* We match up to **3\.5% of your 401k contributions**, ensuring your retirement savings grow alongside your career.
* **6 paid sick and mental health days,** an Employee Assistance Program, free weekly yoga and meditation classes, and additional mental health benefits, because we take a holistic approach to your well\-being.
* Invest in your future with our **Employee Stock Ownership Plan**, where company contributions fund your retirement plan with company stock. Learn more.
* **Reimbursements for a portion of personal cell phone and internet usage** for eligible employees.
* **Professional development** **opportunities** with mentorship, continuous learning programs, and performance\-based pay increases, empowering you to progress and excel in your career.
* Through our charity sponsorships, you can make a positive impact on communities worldwide. We've donated over **$9 million** to date.
* Potential for quarterly KPI bonuses.


The base salary range is $30hr\-$37\.50hr, plus

new_jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger
