new_jobs.title: Resolution Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
WHY JOIN TAXRISE?  


At TaxRise, we don't just provide tax relief services; we provide hope, stability, and solutions to individuals and families facing financial uncertainty. Our team is passionate about reshaping the tax resolution industry through innovation, empathy, and unwavering commitment to our clients.  


Join us and make a tangible difference in people's lives while growing your career with a team that values your contributions.  


ABOUT THE ROLE  


The Case Manager III works directly alongside our Enrolled Agents to help move complex and time\-sensitive tax resolution cases toward successful outcomes.  


While our Enrolled Agents focus on developing resolution strategies and negotiating with the IRS and state taxing authorities, the Resolution Account Manager provides critical case support by communicating with clients, obtaining urgent or additional documentation, coordinating next steps, and ensuring the Enrolled Agents have everything needed to effectively advocate for the client.  


This role will frequently support cases requiring additional attention or urgency, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners. You'll assist with these cases by communicating with the appropriate IRS contacts, tracking requests and deadlines, coordinating required documentation, and keeping the Enrolled Agent informed of important case developments.  


You'll serve as an important connection between the client, the Enrolled Agent, and taxing authorities, helping translate case needs into clear action items and keeping cases moving when timing matters most.  


We're all about that in\-person vibe, so this role is 100% on\-site! If you're excited to work side\-by\-side with our team (or are ready to make the move), then you're a perfect fit. If not, we kindly ask you to hold off on applying. Thanks for understanding and happy job hunting!  


HOW YOU'LL BE REWARDED  


At Tax Rise, Inc., we recognize and reward high performance, ownership, and results.  


Base pay: $24\.00 \- 25\.00 per hour  
Monthly Bonus: Average bonus potential of $1,000 \- $1,500  


Full\-time \| 40 hours per week. Occasional overtime may be required based on business needs.  


WHAT YOU'LL DO  


Enrolled Agents \& Case Support:  


Partner directly with assigned Enrolled Agents to support active tax resolution cases.  
Review case needs and prioritize client outreach based on deadlines, urgency, and direction from the Enrolled Agent.  
Assist with managing priority and time\-sensitive cases, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners.  
Communicate directly with Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners, as appropriate, to provide requested documentation, obtain case updates, clarify outstanding requirements, and coordinate next steps on behalf of the Enrolled Agent.  
Track IRS requests, deadlines, and follow\-up items to ensure required documentation and information are submitted timely and cases continue moving forward.  
Relay important updates, requests, and deadlines from Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners to the assigned Enrolled Agent and coordinate any necessary client follow\-up.  
Maintain clear documentation of IRS communications and escalate case developments requiring the Enrolled Agent's review, strategy, or negotiation.  


Client Communication:  


Serve as a consistent point of contact for assigned case\-related action items.  
Contact clients by phone, email, or approved communication channels to obtain additional financial and tax documentation requested by the Enrolled Agent, IRS, or state taxing authority.  
Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and applicable deadlines.  
Review incoming documentation and promptly follow up on missing or incomplete information.  


CRM Management \& Case Tracking:  


Maintain detailed and accurate CRM notes documenting client conversations, outstanding items, Enrolled Agent requests, deadlines, and case progress.  
Monitor assigned tasks and follow\-ups to ensure urgent requests are completed within required deadlines.  


WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE  


Previous experience in document coordination, loan processing, or a similar administrative role (tax\-related experience is a plus).  
Strong ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.  
Proven experience handling urgent and sensitive client situations while maintaining professionalism and composure.  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex requests in an understandable way.  
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing or incomplete documentation.  
Proficiency in using CRM systems or document management tools; familiarity with tax software is a bonus.  
Strong follow\-up skills and the ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through completion.  
Ability to collaborate closely with Enrolled Agents and follow case\-specific directions..  
Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while meeting deadlines.  
Knowledge of IRS and state tax documentation is a plus; additional training will be provided.  


WHAT WE OFFER  


We believe in taking care of our team so they can take care of our clients. Here's what you can expect as part of the TaxRise family:  


Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (starting after 60 days)  
Paid Time Off  
401(k) retirement plan with company match  
Professional Development Program to support your growth  
Access to our on\-site gym and gaming lounge  
Catered team lunches every Friday  
Fun and energizing quarterly company outings  


ABOUT US  


At TaxRise, our mission is simple yet impactful: to revolutionize the way taxpayers navigate their tax challenges. We believe in the power of lifting others up, and that's the driving force behind everything we do.  


When you join us, you're not just becoming part of a company; you're joining a movement. We'

Location: San Francisco / Bay Area (Home\-Based)  
Territory: Washington, Oregon, Northern California, and surrounding markets

About EX NIHILO

Founded in Paris, EX NIHILO is a contemporary French luxury fragrance house redefining modern perfumery through creativity, innovation, and uncompromising craftsmanship. Inspired by the spirit of bespoke luxury, EX NIHILO creates exceptional olfactory experiences through personalization, artistic collaborations, and a commitment to excellence.

As one of the fastest\-growing luxury fragrance houses, EX NIHILO partners with the world's most prestigious retailers while remaining true to its entrepreneurial spirit and Parisian heritage.

Position Overview

EX NIHILO is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and relationship\-driven Sales Coordinator to support the growth and execution of the brand across the Northwest.

Based in the San Francisco or Bay area, this role will work closely with the Regional Account Executive and National Sales team to support retail partners, maximize sales opportunities, and ensure exceptional execution across the territory.

The Sales Coordinator will support account management, sales initiatives, events, education, merchandising, vendor relationships, and the recruitment and development of Store Ambassadors. This is an ideal opportunity for a polished luxury professional who is passionate about fragrance, commercially minded, and eager to grow within a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial organization.

Key Responsibilities

Sales \& Account Support

* Support the Regional Sales Manager in managing and growing retail business across the Northwest.
* Monitor sales performance, sell\-through, inventory, and productivity across assigned doors.
* Support account business plans, new door openings, launches, events, and key commercial initiatives.
* Prepare sales reports, recaps, and business updates.
* Identify opportunities and challenges and communicate actionable insights to the Regional Sales Manager.

Retail Relationship Management

* Build strong relationships with store leadership, beauty managers, fragrance specialists, personal shoppers, and top\-selling associates.
* Serve as a consistent field contact for assigned retail partners.
* Conduct regular store visits to assess sales performance, team engagement, inventory, merchandising, and brand presentation.
* Support market appointments and retail business meetings.

Store Ambassador \& Talent Management

* Support the recruitment and selection of high\-performing Store Ambassadors and field talent.
* Help identify and attract top talent aligned with EX NIHILO's luxury standards and commercial objectives.
* Support interviewing, onboarding, scheduling, training, and ongoing development of Store Ambassadors.
* Manage day\-to\-day communication and field coordination with Ambassadors.
* Monitor performance, provide feedback, and recognize opportunities to develop and retain top talent.

Vendor \& Field Partner Management

* Manage relationships with third\-party vendors and field partners supporting the Midwest business.
* Coordinate staffing, events, merchandising, and other field initiatives.
* Ensure vendors consistently execute EX NIHILO brand standards and deliver against expectations.
* Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and communicate operational needs to internal teams.

Client Experience \& Education

* Support in\-store events, VIP activations, fragrance experiences, and clienteling initiatives.
* Coordinate event logistics, staffing, product, POSM, and post\-event recaps.
* Support product knowledge and selling trainings in partnership with the Education team.
* Help ensure retail teams and Store Ambassadors are engaged around launches, product storytelling, and commercial priorities.

Merchandising \& Operations

* Conduct regular store visits to ensure brand standards, merchandising, testers, POSM, and product presentation are maintained.
* Communicate inventory, operational, and merchandising needs to internal teams.
* Support new door openings, launches, renovations, and visual merchandising initiatives.
* Maintain accurate account, staffing, calendar, and field activity information.

Cross\-Functional \& Market Support

* Partner with Sales, Education, Marketing, Operations, and Headquarters to ensure seamless execution of initiatives.
* Monitor competitive activity and luxury fragrance trends within the Midwest.
* Share market insights, consumer feedback, and retailer opportunities with the Regional Account Executive and National Sales team.

Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in luxury beauty, fragrance, fashion, or prestige retail.
* Experience with luxury department stores, specialty retailers, or independent fragrance boutiques.
* Experience coordinating Brand Ambassadors, vendors, freelancers, or field teams preferred.
* Strong ability to build relationships and identify high\-performing talent.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
* Strong understanding of luxury retail and exceptional client service.
* Comfortable analyzing sales data and retail performance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently in a home\-based role.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout the Northwest territory.

Preferred Attributes

* Passion for luxury fragrance, beauty, craftsmanship, and exceptional client experiences.
* Polished and sophisticated professional presence.
* Natural ability to identify, attract, and develop top talent.
* Highly organized, proactive, and resourceful.
* Commercially minded with strong attention to detail.
* Collaborative, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable holding partners accountable.
* Entrepreneurial spirit and enthusiasm for a high\-growth luxury organization.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive base salary
* Performance\-based bonus opportunity
* Medical benefits
* Paid

The Role  


For over 20 years, Health Link Home Health \& Hospice has served patients throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We are seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Account Manager to join our Community Relations team and support continued growth throughout Santa Clara County.  


Working closely with the Director of Business Development, the Account Manager will focus on developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare providers, increasing awareness of Health Link's home health services, and generating new referral opportunities throughout the South Bay.  


This is a field\-based role for someone who enjoys building relationships, connecting with healthcare professionals, and developing business within the community. We are looking for someone who is motivated, consistent, organized, and comfortable being accountable for growth goals.  


You will be supported with a company vehicle, ongoing training, and AI\-powered technology designed to provide referral insights and support efficient territory routing.  


What You'll Do  
Develop and maintain referral relationships throughout assigned areas of Santa Clara County

Conduct consistent in\-person outreach, account visits, meetings, presentations, and follow\-up  
Introduce new healthcare partners to Health Link and educate them on our home health services, clinical programs, and capabilities  
Maintain regular communication with existing referral partners and strengthen those relationships over time  
Identify new referral opportunities through consistent field outreach and relationship building  
Follow up with prospective referral partners and maintain consistent account contact  
Execute territory priorities and business development initiatives in partnership with the Director of Business Development

Comfortable conducting in\-person outreach and developing new professional relationships

Performance\-based bonus opportunity  
Company vehicle  
AI\-powered technology to support referral insights and efficient territory routing  
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance  
401(k) with company matching  
Paid time off

new_jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator (Evening Shift)
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:** \- We believe that everyone deserves a home!
  
  

Breaking Ground operates nearly 4,000 units of housing across New York City, along with housing in upstate New York and Connecticut. Supportive housing \- affordable housing paired with services designed to help people maintain their homes for the long\-term \- is widely recognized as a proven and cost\-effective solution to chronic homelessness.
  
  

But we didn't stop at providing housing. Breaking Ground's programs and services help people experiencing street homelessness \- especially those who have been on the streets the longest \- to come indoors. Through our Street to Home outreach program and transitional housing resources, we help people get, and stay, on the path to a permanent home.
  
  

Breaking Ground’s Street to Home program makes regular contact with more than 2,000 street homeless individuals and connects more than 500 individuals to housing, medical and mental health services, substance abuse counseling, and other essential supports each year. The caring, individually tailored attention clients receive at each stage of their journey from street to home ensures that more than 95% of people who Breaking Ground places remain stably housed.
  
  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Programs, Outreach, the Outreach Coordinator manages and supervises street outreach teams, providing coordination across the teams to ensure there is always staff deployed in the field and helps to triage and prioritize urgent requests or developing situations. The Outreach Coordinator ensures the teams utilize Harm Reduction and Housing First approaches when conducting street outreach and engage with individuals to determine homelessness history, services needed, and appropriate placement options from the field in the moment. The Outreach Coordinator creates shift schedules, ensuring continual coverage in the field, and that Housing Advocate teams are compliant with data entry requirements into DHS’ system contractual requirements.
  
  

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for gaining a holistic understanding of the homeless population and works in collaboration with the community and other partners to implement appropriate housing and service solutions. The Outreach Coordinator manages their teams’ responses to community concerns, oversees Code Red/Blue alerts, identifies new hotspots and encampments, plans weekly canvass schedules for the teams, and oversees all 9\.58 assessments and removals for the shift.
  
  

Programs staff are required to locate and assist street homeless individuals under the most extreme weather conditions. Managers are required to be in the field during Code Reds and Code Blues. Staff must be willing to engage with street homeless individuals and can handle multiple tasks in a fast paced, dynamic, team environment.
  
  

This position is primarily the evening shift and has a 35\-hour work week as well as on\-call responsibilities.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**  

Successful oversight and performance management of street outreach teams including Housing Advocates and a Team Leader II who supervises an additional street outreach team and a part time Social Worker
  
  

Provide regular, structured supervision meetings for direct reports
  
  

Responsible for implementing supervisory strategies, and systems of accountability to ensure that staff have adequate support, guidance, and oversight at all times
  
  

Create and implement shift schedules that ensure teams are deployed at all times; find coverage for callouts, vacations, and vacancies
  
  

Ensure canvassing incorporates feedback from the team, community, DHS, historical 311 data, etc
  
  

Promote effective strategies for outreach work, following Housing First, Harm Reduction, Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI), Motivational Interviewing and trauma\-informed care models of practice
  
  

Ensure adherence to program contracts, regulatory requirements, and internal guidelines, ensuring all performance targets and service delivery benchmarks are consistently met
  
  

Responsible for ensuring documentation, reporting, and referrals are accurately completed on time and in compliance with DHS and Breaking Ground requirements
  
  

Provide support and guidance to staff in managing difficult situations and successfully de\-escalating conflict
  
  

Oversee and participate in Code Blue/Red Alerts, providing clinical leadership to the teams when they encounter challenging situations
  
  

Assess and complete 9\.58 involuntary removals to a hospital and ensure all required documentation is accurate and completed on time
  
  

Serve as a liaison with community partners, intergovernmental stakeholders, DHS staff and other community stakeholders to respond to emergent concerns, including 311 calls and encampment engagement
  
  

Develop strong collaborative relationships with external partners and service providers, NYPD, EMS, etc
  
  

Attend onsite meetings with community partners
  
  

Provide on call coverage as needed for the program
  
  

Perform other duties as assigned
  
  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

NYS Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW) required
  
  

Minimum 3 years supervisory experience required
  
  

Obtain 9\.58 credentialing within first 3 months of hire required
  
  

Understanding of Housing First, client centered motivational interviewing, Harm Reduction models, behavioral and medical health systems
  
  

Experience with crisis intervention, including, risk assessments and incident management
  
  

Excellent communication skills (verbally and written) and ability to work with diverse population
  
  

Superb collaborative skills; ability to work successfully with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
  
  

Detailed oriented and can manage team tasks
  
  

Excellent scheduling skills

new_jobs.title: Print Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**SEEN is looking for a highly organized, detail\-driven Print Production Coordinator to help bring campaigns from approved artwork to the streets.**

This role sits at the center of our print and campaign operations, coordinating artwork, production, delivery, and installation across a high volume of campaigns. You’ll work closely with our sales, operations, production, and installation teams to make sure every campaign is produced accurately, delivered on time, and installed exactly as planned.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who likes moving quickly, keeping details straight, solving problems, and seeing their work physically come to life in the city.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate print campaigns from artwork approval through production, delivery, and installation
* Review campaign specs, quantities, sizes, materials, artwork, and production requirements
* Coordinate with internal production teams, printers, installers, and vendors
* Track production schedules and campaign deadlines across multiple active projects
* Confirm artwork is properly prepared and production\-ready
* Manage print orders and ensure the correct materials and quantities are produced
* Coordinate delivery of printed materials to warehouses, installers, and job sites
* Maintain accurate campaign trackers, production schedules, and status updates
* Communicate campaign updates and potential issues to internal teams
* Identify production or scheduling issues early and help find solutions
* Work closely with installation teams to make sure the right materials arrive at the right location at the right time
* Help manage last\-minute changes, reprints, rush orders, and other real\-world campaign needs
* Keep detailed records of campaign materials, costs, deliveries, and completion
* Support post\-campaign reconciliation and reporting
* Additional duties around billboard installation and or tasks may arise during your employment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2\+ years of experience in print production, advertising, OOH, media, marketing operations, or a related field
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills and follow\-through
* Comfortable working with printers, production vendors, and internal teams
* Ability to understand print specifications, materials, quantities, and production requirements
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly
* Resourceful problem solver who doesn’t wait around for someone else to fix an issue
* Someone who takes ownership and understands that the details matter

**The SEEN Mindset**

We work in the physical world. Things have to get printed, delivered, installed, and seen.

That means this role requires someone who is comfortable getting into the details and figuring things out. You should be organized enough to keep hundreds of moving pieces straight, but practical enough to pick up the phone and solve a problem when something doesn't go according to plan.

You don't need to know everything about outdoor advertising on day one. You do need to be curious, accountable, organized, and willing to get into the work.

**About SEEN**

SEEN is an independent outdoor media company built around the streets, cities, and culture that make advertising matter.

We work directly with brands, record labels, artists, agencies, and cultural partners to bring campaigns into the physical world — from street\-level posters and barricades to billboards and large\-scale outdoor installations.

Our work is built to be seen in the places where people actually live, work, move, and play.

* Demonstrated understanding of financial services, specifically within Investment Banking.

Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors

* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

Customer Success

**Why Harvey**
==============


At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.


This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


As a Majors Customer Success Manager, you’ll play a critical role in guiding our largest customers through their journey with Harvey and defining the future of work at elite law firms, Fortune 500 companies and premier asset managers. This position is pivotal in ensuring our customers not only adopt but also derive maximum value from our technology. You'll act as a trusted advisor, deeply integrating Harvey into their business processes, providing expert industry advice and shaping Harvey’s product roadmap.


**What You'll Do**
==================


* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary contact for customers with a prescriptive and consultative approach and as a thought partner to deliver a superior customer experience.
* Strategic Implementation: Lead the integration of Harvey into daily workflows, ensuring seamless adoption and optimal use of our AI solutions.
* Customer Health Monitoring: Proactively and strategically manage overall account health by monitoring key indicators, addressing risks early and driving initiatives that support long\-term customer success and retention.
* Training \& Enablement: Evangelize the power of Harvey as you meet with end users and collaborate with Legal Product Specialists to enable end users to adopt Harvey on a daily\-basis as it becomes a “must have” product.
* Advocacy and Engagement: Direct stakeholder engagement and facilitate executive engagement, transforming customers into Harvey champions within their organizations.
* Feedback Loop: Relay customer insights to our internal teams and collaborate with Product to aid in the continuous improvement of our product and services.
* Travel required: Up to 25% of the time

**What You Have**
=================


* Background in management consulting or technology advisory at a top tier management consulting firm, or strategic customer success/account management experience in an Enterprise SaaS or legal (big law or in\-house or in\-house) environment
* History and comfort conducting change management and wide\-scale adoption for large technology projects.
* Excellent communication and strategic planning skills, and a capability of influencing stakeholders at every level, including at the executive level.
* Results driven mindset and the ability to ruthlessly prioritize competing tasks and demanding customers seamlessly.
* A strong commitment to be collaborative and proactive with a team\-first mentality.

**What We Offer**
=================


* A chance to be at the forefront of AI technology and innovation, directly impacting how our customers' businesses operate and thrive.
* An opportunity to contribute to the growth and direction of our rapidly\-evolving Customer Success program, building out best\-in\-class playbooks and processes.
* A collaborative work environment that promotes growth, learning, and development.

**Compensation Range**
======================


* $180,000\-$210,000 OTE with an 80/20 split

Leveraging proprietary datasets, an advanced operating system, and a carefully curated network of 5,000\+ trusted vendors, we help companies of all shapes and sizes streamline their operations while advancing sustainability efforts.

Sourgum is seeking a dynamic and driven individual to join our team as a Vendor Relationship Manager. **About the Role**
------------------



We are looking for a **B2B Community Manager** to lead the day\-to\-day management and development of our client's social communities across **LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube and X**, with Instagram also forming part of the wider social ecosystem.



This is a strategic and operational role, responsible for ensuring consistent, high\-quality community engagement while helping shape how the brand participates in conversations across social channels. You will establish governance frameworks, manage content planning and publishing, develop social copy, monitor and respond to community interactions, and work closely with internal teams and external production partners to ensure social activity aligns with the brand's strategic direction.



The role requires someone who can balance **strategic thinking with hands\-on delivery** and who understands how to engage B2B audiences across different platforms.


### **Responsibilities:**


**Community \& Social Governance**


* Develop and maintain a clear **governance strategy for content management and community engagement** across social channels.
* Establish best practices, processes and guidelines for publishing, engagement, escalation and response management.
* Ensure social activity consistently aligns with the client's **North Star, brand strategy and Social Playbook**.
* Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness, consistency and quality of community engagement.
* Act as a subject matter expert on B2B community management, bringing platform and audience expertise to wider social strategy.


**Content Planning \& Publishing**


* Create and manage a **monthly social content calendar**, where influence and oversight of the client's wider content planning allows.
* Recommend appropriate **frequency, timing and channel distribution** for social content based on audience behaviour and platform best practice.
* Manage daily channel activity, including **scheduling and publishing content across LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube and X**, with Instagram incorporated where required.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure content is approved, accurately scheduled and published on time.
* Identify opportunities to optimise content for individual platforms and audience behaviours.


**Copy \& Content Optimisation**


* Create and optimise **master asset copy** for campaigns and ongoing community interaction.
* Adapt messaging and copy for different social channels while maintaining a consistent brand voice.
* Develop engaging responses to community interactions, ensuring communications are relevant, authentic and appropriate for a B2B audience.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose and extend existing content through social\-first engagement and conversation.


**Community Management**


* Monitor social channels and actively manage community interactions across the client's social ecosystem.
* Manage up to **800 community engagements per month**, including comments, questions, mentions and other audience interactions.
* Respond to audiences in line with established governance, tone of voice and escalation processes.
* Identify emerging topics, recurring questions, audience sentiment and opportunities for proactive engagement.
* Escalate sensitive, complex or potentially reputational issues to the appropriate stakeholders. This can include detrimental statements from current or former employees, as well as brand\-damaging posts, pages, or entities.
* Build meaningful relationships with relevant audiences, industry voices and communities.


**Creative \& Production Oversight**


* Direct the assessment and enhancement of existing creative assets with the **incumbent production agency**.
* Provide clear briefs and strategic guidance to ensure creative assets align with the client's **North Star and Social Playbook objectives**.
* Collaborate with creative and production partners to identify opportunities to improve the relevance, effectiveness and social performance of existing assets.
* Challenge and refine creative where required, ensuring assets are appropriate for the intended audience, platform and objective.
* Connect creative execution with broader content, community and social strategy.


**Insights, Reporting \& Optimisation**


* Monitor community and content performance to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Use social and audience data to inform content planning, publishing cadence and engagement strategy.
* Provide regular community insights and recommendations to improve social performance.
* Feed audience and community learnings back into wider content and social strategy.
* Autonomously monitor social media platforms via enterprise management tools to identify and escalate significant brand mentions across non\-client owned forums (e.g., Reddit), articles, blogs, and press releases.
* Track and flag sensitive mentions from high\-impact sources, including government officials, major technology companies, and influential public figures.
* Monitor for and escalate content involving geopolitical issues or sensitivities.

* Collaborate with the client's internal teams and incumbent agency partners to ensure effective content planning and execution.

**About AAPC**

Azarkian Architecture P.C. is a compliance\-first architectural firm rooted in NYC’s complex regulatory landscape. We specialize in zoning, space planning, and architectural solutions for commercial and mixed\-use properties, with a focus on NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) and agency approvals. Our work bridges creative design with regulatory precision, helping clients unlock legal occupancies, navigate code barriers, and bring projects into compliance. AAPC is the architectural arm of Azark Inc., part of a broader platform of building\-related companies offering integrated architecture, construction, project management, and compliance services under one roof.

**Position Overview**

We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive, and tech\-forward Executive Assistant to support the principal and help manage the daily operations of a fast\-paced architectural, construction, and compliance\-driven office. This role is ideal for someone who can balance high\-level executive support with office management, operations coordination, and administrative follow\-through across multiple active projects and business functions.

The ideal candidate is polished, dependable, and solutions\-oriented, with strong judgment and a high sense of ownership. A background in operations, billing, invoicing, office administration, or project coordination within architecture, construction, real estate, or professional services is strongly preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Location:
Atlanta, GA, US, 30339  

  

**Best People \+ Right Culture. These are the driving forces behind JE Dunn’s success.**


**By hiring inspired people, giving them interesting and challenging work, enabling them with innovative tools, and letting them share in the company’s rewards, we’ve found a sustainable way to grow in our industry for the last 100\+ years.**


**Our diverse teams around the country strive to enrich lives through inspired people and places everyday, and we need inspired people like you to join us in building authentic partnerships.**


**Role Summary**
----------------


The Project Coordinator will provide routine administrative support to internal and external project management team members. This position will collect, process, input, organize and file data and documentation from various sources and stakeholders in order to support the administrative, documentation, data, reporting, compliance and communications needs of projects. All activities will be performed in support of the strategy, vision and values of JE Dunn.


* Autonomy \& Decision Making: Follows directions and refers all exceptions to supervisor.
* Career Path: Senior Project Coordinator
**Key Role Responsibilities \- Core**
-------------------------------------


*PROJECT COORDINATOR – CORE*
  

* Utilizes responsibility matrix (WorkSmart) to ensure alignment with ongoing business process improvement efforts, supporting full project lifecycle.
* Collects, processes, inputs, organizes and files data and documentation from various sources and stakeholders as requested by project management team in accordance with established business processes.
* Processes information within specific timeframes in order to maintain efficiency and timeliness.
* Provides timely and effective communication to internal and external stakeholders.
* Supports project management during the bidding process, with deliverables such as creating bid invitations, preparing specifications documents, addressing regulatory and compliance requirements and creating, tracking and following up on bid communications.
* Supports project management during the award process by;

o Issuing and/or preparing bond memos
  

o Setting up, issuing, and fully executing subcontracts
  

o System access to dashboards
  

* Organizes information into standard formats and reports in various systems and locations such as the project dashboard, CMiC, electronic signature tools, etc. Maintains documents per established file structure.
* Coordinates submission of project documentation per project requirements. Prepares routine correspondence (such as letters, emails, meeting notes and proposals) and reviews outgoing materials for conformance with best practice standards and formats.
* Creates and distributes potential change items (PCIs) and requests for information (RFIs). Follows up as needed to include pricing efforts and distribution of change orders.
* Supports project management with project deliverables, such as managing information on the project dashboard and electronically processing various documents (such as submittals, pay applications, bills of sale, compliance documentation, requests for information and change documents).
* Tracks, monitors and/or collaborates with internal stakeholders to ensure necessary documentation (such as badging, certified payroll, diversity reporting, insurance certificates, bonds, lien waivers, affidavits, etc.) meets compliance requirements before releasing payments to subcontractors.
* May receive and direct incoming telephone calls and visitors or provide additional administrative support to other functions to help meet business and staffing needs.
* Shares subject matter expertise to support teamwork and deliver results.
* Utilizes discretion and integrity with highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Demonstrates commitment to the highest standards of customer satisfaction by displaying courtesy and sensitivity and responding promptly to customer needs.
* Manages difficult or emotional customer situations promptly and efficiently.
* Meets client commitments; recognizes and acts upon service opportunities.
* Solicits and applies feedback to improve quality and service.
* May support various administrative needs for the project team as needed, such as arranging team member travel, managing expense reporting, etc.
**Key Role Responsibilities \- Additional Core**
------------------------------------------------


N/A


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
----------------------------------


* Ability to perform work accurately and completely, and in a timely manner
* Communication skills, verbal and written
* Proficiency in MS Office
* Organizational skills
* Ability to work collaboratively and cross\-functionally to obtain information or solve problems in support of the team’s goals
* Critical thinking ability
* Ability to deliver quality through attention to detail
* Ability to learn and use a variety of software, tools and systems necessary to meet business needs
* Knowledge of administrative, office and general billing procedures
* Ability to build relationships and collaborate within a team, internally and externally
**Education**
-------------


High School Diploma or GED (Required).


**Experience**
--------------


* 2\+ years administrative or clerical support experience (Required)
* 2\+ years construction project support experience (Preferred)
**Working Environment**
-----------------------


* Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds
* May require periods of travel
* Must be willing to work non\-traditional hours to meet project needs
* Normal office environment, but may be exposed to extreme conditions (hot or cold)
* Frequent activity: Sitting, Viewing Computer Screen
* Occasional activity: Standing, Walking, Bending, Climbing, Reaching above Shoulder, Pushing, Pulling
**Benefits Information**
------------------------


The benefits package aligned to this position is Professional Non\-Unio

PROGRAM COORDINATOR

**Smart from the Start**  
**Location:** Atlanta, GA \| Southwest Atlanta  
**Position:** Full\-Time  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, with some evenings and weekends required  
**Travel:** Local/corporate travel as needed  
**Reports To:** Program Manager  
**Compensation:** Starting salary commensurate with experience

**ABOUT SMART FROM THE START**

Smart from the Start is a family support, community engagement, and school readiness organization committed to strengthening children, families, and communities. We work alongside families to provide the resources, relationships, and opportunities they need to thrive while helping create stronger pathways to school readiness, family stability, and long\-term success.

Our work is rooted in the belief that families already possess strengths, knowledge, and resilience. Our role is to meet families where they are, build trust, connect them to resources, and create meaningful opportunities for children and caregivers to learn, grow, and connect.

Smart from the Start serves families across Boston, Atlanta, Washington, DC, and Philadelphia through our **“Four Cities, One Family”** approach.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Smart from the Start is seeking a **Program Coordinator** to join our Atlanta team and help lead site\-based programming, family engagement, case management, and community outreach efforts in Southwest Atlanta.

This is a highly community\-facing position for someone who enjoys working directly with children and families, building relationships, creating engaging programming, connecting families to resources, managing family support needs, and being part of the day\-to\-day work that makes a community program successful.

The Program Coordinator will work closely with the Program Manager and Smart staff to facilitate programming, provide case management and family support, strengthen community partnerships, engage families, support outreach efforts, maintain accurate participant records, and ensure programs are organized, welcoming, and responsive to the needs of the community.

The ideal candidate is someone who can walk into a room, connect with families, build relationships with community partners, roll up their sleeves when needed, and help turn an idea into a successful program or event.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Program Leadership \& Facilitation

*Facilitates and leads Early Childhood and caregiver programming while providing support to youth development activities and broader family programming as needed.*

* Facilitate Smart from the Start core programming at designated Atlanta program sites.
* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of family and child\-focused programming.
* Provide direct services, education, support, and resources to children and families.
* Create welcoming and engaging environments that encourage families to participate and remain connected to Smart.
* Support family\-centered events, workshops, community activities, and special initiatives.
* Participate in staff meetings, trainings, planning sessions, and other organizational activities.

Case Management \& Family Support

* Provide ongoing case management and family support to assigned participants.
* Complete family intake, needs assessments, goal setting, service planning, referrals, and follow\-up.
* Work with families to identify strengths, needs, barriers, and goals.
* Develop individualized support plans in collaboration with families.

* Make referrals and follow up with families and service providers to support successful connections to services.
* Maintain appropriate and timely case notes, referral documentation, and participant records.
* Monitor family engagement and progress toward identified goals.
* Collaborate with Smart staff, community partners, schools, and service providers when additional support or coordination is needed.
* Respond appropriately to family crises and connect families to appropriate crisis intervention and stabilization resources.
* Maintain professional boundaries and protect participant confidentiality.

Family Engagement \& Outreach

* Develop and implement outreach strategies to increase awareness and participation in Smart programming and services.
* Build trusting relationships with parents, caregivers, children, residents, and community members.
* Maintain consistent communication with families and encourage continued participation.
* Conduct community outreach through events, meetings, flyers, partnerships, door\-to\-door engagement, and other strategies.
* Identify barriers that may prevent families from participating and work with the Smart team to develop solutions.
* Support participant retention and engagement throughout the program year.

Database \& Data Management

* Enter, update, and maintain accurate participant and family information in Smart's database and electronic data systems.
* Ensure participant demographic information, program enrollment, attendance, services, referrals, case notes, and other required information are entered accurately and in a timely manner.
* Regularly review database records for missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information and make necessary corrections.
* Maintain accurate documentation to support program reporting, evaluation, funding requirements, and organizational outcomes.

* Maintain confidentiality and follow organizational policies regarding participant information and data security.

Customer\-facing business development is led by the Head of BD; your role is to make sure everything behind that is organized, on time, and well\-connected inside Mercedes\-Benz.


Responsibilities:


* Serve as the BD team's primary interface with MBUSA, MB AG, and other Mercedes\-Benz entities, navigating the corporate structure to identify the right internal contacts, build working relationships, and move approvals, requests, and information efficiently through the organization.
* Own the team's budget execution: track spend against approved budget lines, process purchase orders and vendor invoices, coordinate with MBNAC finance, and flag variances early with recommended corrective action.

* Organize and lead the full meeting cadence: weekly stand\-ups, monthly leadership reviews, internal stakeholder syncs, and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.
* Manage timelines and deliverables across all business\-team workstreams: milestone tracking, decision log, risk register, and an integrated dashboard reporting against published KPIs.

* Track progress across all workstreams and provide concise executive updates on status, risks, and opportunities; conduct variance analyses and coordinate corrective actions with responsible stakeholders.

**HAWQUE PROTECTION GROUP****JOB DESCRIPTION — ACCOUNT MANAGER**

 **Position Title**  

Account Manager **Division**  

Operations Division **Employment Classification**  

Full\-Time, W\-2, Non\-Exempt **Compensation**  

$22\.00\-$24\.00 per hour **Location**  

HPG Buckhead Headquarters and/or assigned client site(s) — varies by account **Expected Hours**  

Approximately 40 hours per week **Work Arrangement**  

Office\-Based / Client Site\-Based / Multi\-Site / Hybrid, based on assigned account

 **Position Overview**


The Account Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day operational health of assigned HPG client accounts and serves as a key link between clients, Site Leads, Security Guards, and Operations leadership. The role oversees scheduling and coverage, site operations, field communication, personnel accountability, report compliance, client service, and operational follow\-through. Account Managers are expected to resolve routine matters within their authority, maintain accurate documentation, identify emerging risks, and escalate higher\-risk issues with clear context and a recommended solution.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **Scheduling \& Coverage:** Maintain schedules for assigned account(s), identify and resolve coverage gaps, coordinate available resources, communicate schedule changes, and track recurring staffing issues or patterns.
* **Account \& Site Oversight:** Conduct regular site visits and operational follow\-up, monitor open site issues, and help ensure assigned locations operate in accordance with contract requirements, HPG standards, safety expectations, and site\-specific post orders.
* **Guard \& Site Lead Accountability:** Maintain active communication with assigned Guards and Site Leads; address attendance, uniform, post\-order, conduct, and performance concerns; coach and document follow\-up; and elevate matters requiring formal discipline or termination review.
* **Escalation \& Problem Solving:** Serve as the first operational contact for routine guard and site concerns. Resolve issues within delegated authority and escalate client risk, formal discipline, termination recommendations, or other higher\-risk decisions with clear facts, context, and a recommended solution.
* **Systems, Reporting \& Documentation:** Support first\-level Connecteam troubleshooting; confirm correct site, department, form, and workflow assignments; monitor Daily Activity Reports and incident reports for completion and quality; and maintain timely Monday.com, email, and operational records.
* **Training \& Client Service:** Reinforce HPG standards, support field onboarding and role training, coach personnel on communication, reporting, client service, and post orders, flag skill gaps, and maintain professional, responsive relationships with assigned clients.
* **Site Transitions \& Reporting Up:** Support account handoffs, client and guard communications, system reassignments, documentation, and follow\-up. Provide recurring updates to the reporting manager on coverage, personnel concerns, client risks, report compliance, open tasks, and operational trends.
 **Qualifications**

* Experience in security operations, account or client service, scheduling, site coordination, or a comparable field\-based service environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, coverage needs, site concerns, and routine operational issues with sound judgment and consistent follow\-through.
* Strong leadership, coaching, problem\-solving, de\-escalation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and documentation skills for working with clients, Security Guards, Site Leads, peers, and leadership.
* Working proficiency with Connecteam, Monday.com, email, and other company\-designated scheduling, reporting, and communication systems, or the ability to learn them quickly.
* Ability to satisfy applicable background screening and maintain any license, credential, certification, driver qualification, or company training required for assigned duties or client locations.
 **Physical \& Work Requirements**

* Ability to conduct regular client\-site visits and field oversight, including standing, walking, or patrolling for extended periods when operationally necessary.
* Ability to work in varying indoor and outdoor environments, including heat, cold, and rain, during site visits or interim field coverage.
* Ability to travel between HPG offices and assigned client locations and use computer/mobile technology for scheduling, communication, documentation, and operational systems.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
**Work Schedule, Location \& Availability**


This is a full\-time position generally scheduled for approximately 40 hours per week. Work may be performed from HPG’s Buckhead headquarters and/or assigned client site(s), with specific days, hours, and location based on the assigned account and operational needs. Schedule flexibility is required, and evening, weekend, holiday, emergency\-response, client\-meeting, site\-visit, or interim coverage work may be necessary. Account Managers must remain reachable during scheduled work hours and travel to assigned locations as needed.

 **Additional Compensation \& Operations Leadership Perks**

* **On\-Call Weekend Bonus:** Account Managers assigned to the Operations Leadership on\-call rotation are eligible for a $250 bonus for each assigned on\-call weekend, currently expected approximately once per month, subject to operational needs and HPG procedures.
* **Business Mileage Reimbursement:** Account Managers whose regular assignment is not based at a client property may be eligible for authorized business\-mileage reimbursement at the current HPG rate of $0\.70 per mile. Normal commuting mileage is not reimbursable; eligibility varies by assignment and company procedures.

**Company Description** **Overview**


SPANX isn’t your average company. We revolutionized an industry by challenging the status quo and putting the customer first. You might know the story: our founder, Sara Blakely, needed a base layer for her white pants, so she cut the legs off a pair of tights and SPANX was born. The spark of that origin is the fuel for our future. We grew up in shapewear. But we’ve graduated. For over 25 years, we've been experimenting, innovating, and giving women what they want and what they deserve. Because we are those women. And we’re honored to create on behalf of us all.

* Develop a deep understanding of each account’s in\-store presentation, traffic patterns, promotional cadence, associate engagement, and consumer behavior to inform strategies that maximize business performance.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Planning, Operations, Marketing, Merchandising, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of account strategies and customer initiatives.

 **Qualifications** **We require…**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in wholesale account management, sales, or a related role within apparel, fashion, or consumer products, preferably working with national or department store retailers.
* Demonstrated experience managing and growing wholesale accounts and building strong relationships with retail Buyers and Management teams.
* Strong financial and analytical acumen, with experience analyzing retail sales, margin performance, inventory, assortment productivity, forecasting, and open\-to\-buy.
* Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated ability to translate complex retail data into clear insights and actionable business strategies.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently lead customer meetings and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities.

new_jobs.description:
At JFrog, we're reinventing DevOps to help the world's greatest companies innovate \- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all\-around great people. Here, if you're willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone's lives, you'll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production \- a concept we call "liquid software." Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?



We are looking for a meticulous, proactive, and collaborative to join our Renewals team.



In this role, you will be a key driver of the "Liquid Software" vision by ensuring our customers' journey with JFrog remains seamless and uninterrupted. By mastering the renewals lifecycle, you enable the world's leading organizations to maintain their continuous delivery pipelines with confidence and speed. Your technical precision in account management ensures that the flow of innovation never stops, making you a vital architect of our customer retention and long\-term success.


#### **As a Customer Retention Associate Account Manager in JFrog you will...**


* Scale the renewals process by architecting accurate quotes and opportunities across a targeted global portfolio.
* Drive operational excellence by collaborating with Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to ensure 100% contract accuracy and compliance.
* Maximize customer retention by proactively managing the end\-to\-end renewal lifecycle within your assigned territory.
* Optimize Salesforce data integrity to provide real\-time visibility into renewal health and territory performance.
* Accelerate business growth by identifying expansion opportunities and providing actionable insights during the renewal cycle leading with AI.
* Streamline the customer experience by orchestrating high\-touch communications and resolving complex back\-office administrative tasks.

#### **To be a** **Customer Retention Associate Account Manager** **in JFrog you need...**


* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in account management, renewals, or sales operations within a SaaS environment.
* Proven track record of managing high\-volume portfolios and meeting tight deadlines with exceptional attention to detail.
* Advanced proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC) and the MS Office Suite, particularly Excel for data tracking and reporting.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex internal processes and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively engage with both internal stakeholders and external customer liaisons.
* Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth technical environment where adaptability and a "Froggy" spirit are essential.

#### **WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…**


* At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.
* This position has a base salary range between $75,000 to $90,000\. Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

* JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!
* JFrog embraces hybrid work: 3 days in office / 2 days remote.


JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill \+ passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

**Job Description:**


This position on the Customer Success Team works with customers and business partners across multiple business functions to help successfully set up and onboard customers onto their UPS Capital solution. This position is responsible for ensuring successful customer setup and onboarding, as well as providing subject matter expertise support throughout the initial stages of the customer journey. Additionally, this position serves as a single point of contact for all customer inquiries post\-purchase to provide expedient resolution of customer inquiries, requests, and issues.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Supports successful and expedient activation and onboarding of customers (Direct, Channels \& Platforms) to expedite transaction production, increase customer retention, and reduce churn
* Provides a seamless onboarding customer experience through the initial stages of the customer journey using a combination of interactive demonstrations, proactive customer outreach and follow up, and daily activity monitoring
* Trains customers on tools, systems, and solutions to ensure thorough customer understanding
* Nurtures customers through activation and proper solution usage and proactively resolve customer issues
* Audits customer milestones for accuracy and operational effectiveness, and provide expedient resolution of issues (milestones include solution go\-live, first transaction, first bill, first claim)
* Troubleshoots technical issues in real\-time (live) for customers’ digital solutions and coordinate technical issue resolution with IT
* Balances multiple deployments and onboarding schedules to meet stakeholder goals and expectations
* Provides one centralized place for all customer support and inquiries, providing an easy and seamless customer support experience with one\-call resolution (onboarding and technology integration, policy information \& modifications, customer service and account information, billing, claims)
* Collect Voice of Customer feedback to help inform product and roadmap strategy and design

 **QUALIFICATIONS**


Requirements:

* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong digital literacy and fluency in different technology solutions and systems
* Strong time management and organizational skills
* Great active listening skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and rapport building skills
* Demonstrates a detailed understanding of supply chain concepts
* Demonstrates a basic understanding of risk management principles; identifies the risk factors that impact a client’s insurance needs
* Demonstrates a general understanding of ways to identify and measure the current needs of the customer
* Demonstrates change agility and flexibility
* Candidate must obtain their Insurance License for Property and Casualty \- Preferred

* The internal Grade Level for this position is a 10D
* Candidate must be geographically located in the same region as position or willing to self\-relocate.
* Position is on a hybrid schedule (Tuesday\-Thursday in office; Monday and Friday remote)
* The last day to apply is 10/6/2026 at 11:59pm ET

**Employee Type:**


Permanent

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National of the U.S., an alien lawfully admitted for permanent residence, or an alien authorized to work in the U.S. for this employer.

We've grown to be the largest family\-operated broadline food distribution company in North America by being passionately committed to the people we serve.  



  

At Gordon Food Service, our customers come first. As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you will cultivate relationships, develop new business, and provide innovative solutions to our customers, helping them to achieve their goals and, in return, yours!  



  

This position will reside in: **Alpharetta, GA.**

  

**Position Benefits**
=====================

* A generous 401(k) matching program that is above industry standards
* Financial rewards for performance compensation structure which includes salary, commission, and bonuses
* Low\-cost benefit options for you and your family's health and future
* An Automobile expense reimbursement plan
Cell phone reimbursement plan

**Outside Food Sales Representative**
=====================================

This includes pursuing new customers, deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships, and sales territory management.  



  

**Pursuing New Customers**

* Researching industry and market trends impacting restaurants within your territory
* Identifying and researching prospective customers within your territory

**Deepen and Strengthen Existing Customer Relationships**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Visiting all customers within the assigned territory on a weekly, bi\-weekly, or monthly basis
* Conducting business reviews to determine existing customers needs and areas of opportunity for growing sales
* Providing ongoing training to customers on Gordon Food Service product offerings
Identifying opportunities within existing customers businesses where Gordon Food Service can add value through product and service offerings  
* 

  

**Sales Territory Management**

* Balancing new customers acquisition and deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships
* Coordinating visits to prospective customers and existing customers
Communicating order status and order processing updates to customers  
* 

  

**Sales Training \- Getting you Ready**
=======================================

Gordon Food Service’s goal during your first 90 days is to set you up for success! This includes engaging you in various training offerings, including e\-learning, classroom sessions, video roleplays, job shadowing, and peer sales representative mentorship. Throughout your first 90 days, you will learn:


* How to use Gordon Food Service systems, processes, and tools to manage customer relationships
* About the products available to Gordon Food Service customers
* The sales process for engaging new customers
* How to establish your relationships in the vast network of resources available to you, a Gordon Food Service sales representative
* Best practices on developing relationships with current and prospective customers
Strategies on how to effectively manage your territory

**Position Requirements**

**WHO WE ARE**



Interdependence is a tech\-powered, integrated marketing and communications agency built around one core belief: strategy comes first.



Founded in public relations, we've grown into a full\-service partner spanning PR, social media, paid media, brand strategy and consulting, event marketing, influencer marketing, website strategy and development, and integrated marketing planning. We continue to expand our capabilities based on what our clients need and where we can make the greatest impact.



Our approach starts with our clients' goals, not a predetermined set of services. We look at the bigger picture, identify the channels and strategies best positioned to drive results, and build the right plan around them. When the best solution falls outside our own capabilities, we're willing to say so. Achieving our clients' goals is always the priority.



We combine smart strategy, experienced people and technology, including our Newsweek AI Impact Award\-winning Interviewed™ platform, to deliver measurable results. Just as importantly, we believe how we work matters. Kindness, collaboration, curiosity and accountability shape how we partner with our clients and each other. As a remote team, we're building an agency where great people can do great work, grow their careers and feel valued along the way.

  


**THE MISSION**


**Help turn client goals into organized, thoughtful marketing programs while becoming a trusted, proactive contributor to the Integrated Marketing \& Strategy team.**



Our team supports clients across influencer marketing, events, brand strategy and identity, website strategy and development and other integrated marketing needs. Account Executives help connect the client, the strategy and the people responsible for bringing the work to life.



Your job is to keep projects moving, communicate clearly, anticipate what is needed next and help solve problems before they become roadblocks. As you grow in the role, the expectation is that you look beyond assigned tasks, develop stronger client and business judgment, and take greater ownership of day\-to\-day work.

* **Client goals come first.** Start with what the client needs to accomplish, then help determine the channels, partners and next steps best positioned to support that goal.

* **Be curious and resourceful.** You will not always have an immediate answer. Ask smart questions, research options, talk to new people and bring forward a recommended path rather than stopping at the problem.

  


**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


* **You are not expected to arrive as an expert in every marketing channel.** Specific influencer, event, brand or website experience is helpful but not required. You are expected to learn quickly, understand how different disciplines work together and build broader channel knowledge over time.
* **You are not expected to lead client strategy alone.** Senior team members own overarching strategy, senior counsel and complex client conversations. You are expected to understand that strategy, contribute ideas and increasingly connect your work to the client's broader goals.

* Review materials for accuracy, completeness and alignment with the brief before they are shared internally or with clients.


**Influencer Programs \& Events**


* Research creators, partners, vendors, venues and other resources that align with client goals, audiences and budgets.
* Support outreach, vetting, contracting, logistics, content reviews, approvals, product shipments, guest lists, invitations and other program details.
* Communicate professionally with creators, vendors and new contacts and confidently ask the questions needed to evaluate options or solve problems.
* Provide on\-site event and activation support as needed and remain calm, flexible and solutions\-focused when plans change.


**Creative \& Strategic Contribution**


* Actively contribute ideas during brainstorms, planning sessions and account discussions.
* Conduct research that helps the team understand audiences, competitors, cultural trends, potential partners and new approaches.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

**About the Job**


The Associate Project Manager \- UAX Fleet is a pivotal cross\-functional role within the United Express organization responsible for managing the end\-to\-end execution of aircraft modification and fleet enhancement initiatives. This position partners with engineering teams, maintenance providers, airline partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver complex projects that improve the customer experience while minimizing aircraft downtime and operational disruption. The successful candidate combines strong project management discipline, technical aptitude, financial oversight, and stakeholder management skills to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with regulatory requirements.

**Core Accountabilities**

* Lead the planning and execution of aircraft modification and fleet enhancement projects from project initiation through implementation.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and change control processes to effectively manage scope, budget, schedules, and dependencies.
* Coordinate activities across partner airlines, maintenance facilities, engineering teams, vendors, procurement, and internal stakeholders to ensure project success.
* Monitor project budgets, vendor invoices, and cost performance while providing recommendations to address variances and maintain financial objectives.
* Prepare executive status reports, steering committee materials, and project updates that clearly communicate progress, risks, mitigation plans, and resource requirements.
* Support contract\-related activities including Statements of Work (SOWs), service agreements, procurement coordination, and vendor management.
* Translate technical requirements, engineering data, service bulletins, and modification documentation into executable project timelines while supporting FAA compliance activities.

Apply critical thinking to validate AI\-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy and security.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Aviation, Management, or a related technical or quantitative discipline

MMG is a sales, marketing and service agency which supports cabinet manufacturers and dealers in the Midwest. We produce market information to implement product platforms and marketing strategies for our business partners to ensure growth goals. We provide representation that builds partnerships with manufacturers and dealers, in addition to developing new profitable business opportunities.

**Job Overview:**

***We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Cabinet Sales Representative to join our team.*** In this role, you will represent and promote the products of three different cabinet manufacturers to our clients and customers. You will be responsible for developing relationships with dealers through (1\) sales, (2\) service and (3\) training in the field. If you have a passion for cabinetry and a proven track record in sales, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Sales**

**Product Knowledge:** Develop a deep understanding of the cabinet products and resources offered by each manufacturer we represent, including their features, benefits, and customization options.

**Sales and Business Development:** Actively seek out new dealers and identify opportunities for sales growth with all accounts in a designated territory.

**Dealer Relationship Management:** Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with dealers. Understand their business needs and preference to provide tailored cabinet solutions.

**2\. Service**

**Quoting and Pricing:** Prepare accurate price quotes for customers based on their specifications and requirements.

**Customer Support:** Address customer inquiries, concerns, and issues promptly and professionally. Provide post\-sale support and assistance as needed.

**Reporting:** Maintain detailed records of sales activities, client interactions, and sales forecasts. Prepare regular reports for management and manufacturers.

**3\. Training** 

**Product Presentation:** Conduct product presentations and demonstrations for clients and customers. Highlight the unique selling points and advantages of each manufacturer's cabinets.

**Market Research:** Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities. Provide feedback to manufacturers on market conditions and customer preferences.

**Collaboration:** Work closely with the manufacturers' representatives, internal teams, and external partners to ensure a seamless sales process and exceptional customer experience.

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to multitask and manage time effectively.

**Education and Experience:**

* Experience with CRM software and Google Workspace (preferred).

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

* 75% (Preferred)
